verses.t: Mu buku langa loyamba ndinakuuzani, Teofilo, za zonse zimene Yesu anayamba kuchita ndi kufunza,
mpaka tsiku limene anapita kumwamba, atapeleka malangizo ena kwa atumwi ake osankhidwa kudzera mu Mzimu Woyera.
Atadzumirira ndi kumfa, anaonekera kwa atumwi nthawi zambiri mu masiku makumi anayi, nawaonetsa mbali zambiri kuti anali moyo. Analankhula nawo za ufumu wa Mulungu.
Pamodzi nawo pa chakudya, anawalamula, "Musachoke ku Yerusalemu mpaka Atate akakumuzani mphatso imene analonjeza, monga ndinakuuzani kale.
Yohane anabatiza ndi madzi, koma mudzabatizidwa ndi Mzimu Woyera patangopita masiku ochepa."
Choncho atumwi ali pamodzi ndi Yesu, anakamupempha, "Ambuye, kodi nthawi yabwera kuti mudzabwezere ufumu kwa Israeli?"
Anawayankha, "Si inu kudziwa masiku ndi nthawi zimene Atate wazisunga m'ulamuliro wake wokha.
Koma mudzalandira mphamvu Mzimu Woyera akadzafika pa inu. Mudzakhala mboni zanga ku Yerusalemu, ndi mu Yudeya yonse, ndi ku Samariya, ndi mpaka kumalekezero a dziko lapansi."
Atanena izi, anapita kumwamba pamene ankumaona, nekhamu linaamwira, sanamuonenso.
Akayang'anizira kumwamba pamene ankupita, amuna awiri oyala zojira zoyera anaimirira mwa iwo mwamsanga.
Anati, "Inu amuna a Galileya, muimererani chifukwa chani muyang'ana kumwamba? Yesu amene anakuchokerani kupita kumwamba, adzabwerananso momwemo monga munamuona akupita."
Kenako atumwi anabwerera ku Yerusalemu kuchoka ku Phiri la Maolivi, lokhala patali wa makilomita amodzi.

Atafika, analowa m'chipinda chamwamba cha nyumba imene ankukhala. Mayina a amene anali kumeneko ndi: Petro, Yohane, Yakobo, Andireya, Filipo, Tomasi, Bartolomayo, Mateyu, Yakobo mwana wa Alefayo, Simoni Wokhulupirika, ndi Yuda mwana wa Yakobo.
Onse anasonkhana pamodzi, nthawi zonse kupereka mapemphero, pamodzi ndi Mariya amayi a Yesu, ndi amai ena, ndi abale a Yesu.
M'masiku amenewa, ophunzira okwana mazana awiri ndi makumi awiri anasonkhana pamalo amodzi, Petro anaimirira, nanalankhulia.
Anati, "Abale, Malemba anayenera kukwaniritsidwa pa Yuda amene anatsogolera iwo amene anagwira Yesu. Mzimu Woyera ananeneratu izi kudzera mwa Mfumu Davidi.
Yuda anali mmodzi wa ife, nalandira gawo la utumiki uno pamodzi nafe."
(Yuda anagula munda ndi ndalama zimene analandira chifukwa cha chiwembu chake. Anagwa nkhope pansi, ndi thupi lake linagawika, matumbo ake onse anatayika.
Onse okhala ku Yerusalemu anamva za imfa yake, ndipo analitcha malo amenewo m'Chiaramu Akeldama, kutanthauza "Munda wa Magazi.")
Petro anati, "Izi zinalembedwa m'buku la Masalimo, kuti, 'Nyumba yake isikhale bwino, palibe munthu kukhala mmenemo.' Ndi kuti, 'Wina akhale m'malo mwake.'
Choncho tsopano tiyenera kusankha wina wotengera malo a Yuda, wa amuna amene anali ndi ife nthawi zonse pamene Ambuye Yesu ankuyenda nafe,
kuyambira kubatizidwa kwake ndi Yohane mpaka tsiku limene anatengeka kuchoka kwa ife. Amene adzasankhidwe adzakhala mboni yake ya kuuka kwake."
Choncho anapendekeza amuna awiri: Yosefe wotchedwa Barsaba (dzina lina lake Yusto) ndi Matiya.
Kenako onse anapempha, "Ambuye, inu mudziwa mitima ya anthu onse. Tionisei amene mwasankha wa amuna awiri awa
kukhala mtumwi kudzatengera malo a Yuda m'utumiki uno, chifukwa iye anatisiya napita kumalo ake."
Natero analowana magoyo, ndipo Matiya anasankhidwa, nakalipira pamodzi ndi atumwi khumi ndi amodzi ena.
Pa tsiku la Pentekoste, okhulupirira onse anali pamodzi pamalo amodzi.
Mwamsanga, panabwera phokoso lochokera kumwamba ngati mkuntho wa mphepo yamphamvu, nalaza nyumba imene anakhala.
Kenako zinthu zooneka ngati moto wa malire zinaonekera nazigawana pakati pawo, zikhala pa aliyense wa iwo.
Onse anadzazidwa ndi Mzimu Woyera, nayamba kulankhula zilankhulo zina, monga Mzimu Woyera anawapatsa kuchita.
Pa nthawi imeneyo anali aYuda odzipereka kuchokera m'mitundu yonse, okhala ku Yerusalemu.
Amva phokoso, gulu linasonkhana, linasangalatika kumva zilankhulo zawo okha zikuyankhulika ndi okhulupirira.
Anakhumudwa kwambiri, anati, "Izi zili bwanji? Anthu awa onse ndi a ku Galileya,
koma ife timawamva akuyankhula zilankhulo zathu tokhazitokha!
Tiri anthu a Pathiya, ndi Mediya, ndi Elamu, okhala m'Mesopotamiya, ndi Yudeya, ndi Kapadokiya, ndi Ponito, ndi chigawo cha Asiya,
ndi Furigiya, ndi Pamfiliya, ndi Iguputo, ndi malo a Libya ozungulira Kurene, ndi alendo ochokera ku Roma
(aYuda ndi otembenukira chikhulupiriro cha chiYuda), ndi anthu a Kurete, ndi Aarabu. Timawamva akuyankhula m'zilankhulo zathu zotokha za zinthu zazikulu zimene Mulungu anachita!"
Anaimirira mosangalatika ndi potanirira, nafunsana, "Kodi ichi chitanthauza chiyani?"
Koma ena m'gulu linakana iwo, anati, "Amwa vinyo wosowa nzeru, ndi manthongo okha!"
Kenako Petro anaimirira pamodzi ndi atumwi khumi ndi amodzi anafuwula kwa gulu, "Imvani bwino, inu nonse, abale a chiYuda ndi anthu okhala ku Yerusalemu! Musaone izi bwino.
Anthu awa sakumwa mowa monga ena a inu akuganiza. Kuchita nthawi imeneyi ya m'mawa wokha ndikutha uko.
Koma ichi ndi chimene Yoweli mneneri anachifotokozerera lino kale:
'M'masiku otsiriza, Mulungu akuti, ndidzathira Mzimu wanga pa anthu onse. Ana anu aamuna ndi aamayi adzanenera. Achichepere anu adzaona masomphenya, akuluakulu anu adzalota maloto.
Nthawi imeneyo ndidzathiranso Mzimu wanga pa antchito anga aamuna ndi aamayi, nanenera.
Ndidzaonetsa zodabwitsa kumwamba, ndi zizindikiro pansi pano, magazi ndi moto ndi fumbi la utsi.
Dzuwa lidzasanduka mdima, ndi mwezi udzasanduka njobvu ya magazi, tsiku lalikulu ndi laulemerero la Yehova lisanafike.
Ndipo aliyense wotcha dzina la Yehova adzapulumuka.'

"Anthu a Israeli, imvani! Mulungu anapereka umboni wa Yesu wa ku Nazareti pakati panu kudzera mu zizindikiro zankhondo ndi zodabwitsa ndi zizindikiro zimene Mulungu anazichitira kudzera mwa iye, monga inu mukudziwa.
Koma Mulungu anadziwa zimene zinadzachitika, ndipo dongosolo lake loneneratu linakwaniritsidwa pamene Yesu anagwiwa. Ndi manja a anthu opanda lamulo, munamkometsa pa mtanda nawomba, namupha.
Koma Mulungu anamuukitsa kuchoka ku imfa, anamumasula ku mantha a imfa, chifukwa imfa sinathe kumugwira.
Davide anati za iye, 'Ndinaona Yehova ali ndi ine nthawi zonse. Iye ali m'mbali mwanga wanja lamanja, choncho sindingagwedezeke.
Ndi chifukwa chake mtima wanga wasangalala, ndi lilime langa litamanda! Thupi langa likhala m'chiyembekezo.
Chifukwa sudzasiya moyo wanga mu manda, kapena kulosera Woyera wako kusola.
Mundionetsa njira ya moyo; mudzandizaza chisangalalo pa maso panu.'
"Abale, chikani m'maganizo inu. Mungathe kuona bwino kuti mkholo Davide sanena za iye mwini, chifukwa anafa nakuikidwa, ndipo manda ake ali nafe mpaka lero.
Koma anali mneneri, nadziwa kuti Mulungu analumbira naye kuti mmodzi wa zipatso za thupi lake adzakhala pa mpando wake wachifumu.
Davide anaona patsogolo ndi kulankhula za kuuka kwa Mesiya, kuti Mulungu samuisiranso ku manda, kapena kulosera thupi lake kusola.
Yesu ameneyu Mulungu anamuukitsa, ndipo ife tonse ndife mboni za ichi.
Atatukulidwa ku malo a ulemerero m'manja mwamanja a Mulungu, nalandira Mzimu Woyera womalonjezedwa ndi Atate, anathira iye pa ife, monga mumuwona ndi kumva lero.
Chifukwa Davide mwini sanakwere kumwamba, koma anati, 'Yehova anauza Ambuye wanga, Khala m'malo a ulemu kumanja kwanga
mpaka ndikasandutse adui ako chopondapo mapazi ako.'
"Choncho Israeli yonse ayenera kudziwa bwino kuti Mulungu wamchita Ambuye ndi Khristu Yesu ameneyu amene munamukometsera pa mtanda!"
Mawu a Petro anawawa mitima yawo, ndipo anauza iye ndi atumwi ena, "Abale, tichite chiyani?"
Petro anawayankha, "Aliyense wa inu atembenuke mtima ndi kutembenukira Mulungu, nabatizidwa m'dzina la Yesu Khristu kuti machimo ake akhululukidwe. Kenako mudzalandira mphatso ya Mzimu Woyera.
Lonjezoli ndi la inu, ndi la ana anu, ndi la onse akutali, onse amene Ambuye Mulungu wathu adzawaitana."
Petro analongerezana kuphunzitsa ndi mawu ena, nakuuza onse, "Dzipulumutseni ku mibadwo yoipa ino!"
Amene anakhulupirira zimene Petro anauza anabatizidwa, naongezedwa ku mpingo tsiku lomwe, pafupifupi anthu mkwi atatu.
Anakhazikika m'chiphunzitso cha atumwi, ndi mgwirizano, ndi kugawana kudya (kuphatikizapo Chakudya cha Ambuye), ndi mapemphero.
Mantha ukulu unawagwira onse, ndipo atumwi anachita zizindikiro zankhondo ndi zodabwitsa zambiri.
Okhulupirira onse anasonkhana pamalo amodzi nakagawana chilichonse chinali nawo.
Anagulitsa katundu ndi zinthu zawo, nagawa ndalama kwa amene anali ndi nsangu.
Tsiku ndi tsiku anasonkhana m'Kachisi pamodzi, nagawana chakudya m'nyumba zawo, nadya ndi chisangalalo ndi mtima woyera,
nthawi zonse natamanda Mulungu, nawakhutira anthu onse. Ndipo tsiku ndi tsiku Ambuye anawonjezera ku mpingo wao amene anali kupulumutsidwa.
Petro ndi Yohane anapita ku Kachisi masana pa nthawi ya mapemphero, pa nthawi ya tatu.
Pafupi ndi khomo la Kachisi, pakhomo lotchedwa Lokongola, anali woyendetsa wopanda mwendo kuyambira anabadwira. Tsiku ndi tsiku ankamuyika kumeneko kuti apemphe anthu olowa m'Kachisi.
Aona Petro ndi Yohane akufuna kulowa, anawapempha ndalama.
Petro ndi Yohane anamuyang'ana, Petro anati, "Tiyang'ane!"
Ndipo anawatunzira mwakudzikhulupirira, adikirira kulandira kachokolo.
Koma Petro anati, "Siliva kapena golidi palibe kwa ine. Koma chimene ndinachiko ndikupatsa inu: M'dzina la Yesu Khristu wa ku Nazareti, imani ndi kuyenda!"
Kenako Petro anagwira dzanja lake lamanja namunyamula. Nthawi yomweyo mapazi ake ndi khonje zinakhazikika naikhazika.
Anasikira, naimirira pa mapazi ake, nayamba kuyenda. Nalowa m'Kachisi nawo akuyenda ndi kusikira ndi kutamanda Mulungu.
Anthu onse anamuona akuyenda nakumva akutamanda Mulungu.
Anamudziwa kuti ndiye wopempha ndalama amene ankukhala pa Khomo Lokongola la Kachisi, nafunidwa kwambiri.
Anali agwira Petro ndi Yohane, anthu onse anathamanga mosangalatika ku Gome la Solomoni, kumene anali.
Petro anaona mwayi woti alankhule kwa anthu, anati, "Anthu a Israeli, mudasangalatika ndi ichi bwanji? Mutiyang'anirenji ngati tanamuuza kuyenda ndi mphamvu yathu tokha kapena kuopa kwathu?
Mulungu wa Abrahamu, ndi Isaaki, ndi Yakobo, Mulungu wa makolo athu, nalemekeza mtumiki wake Yesu. Yesu ameneyu munampeleka ndi kumukana pamaso pa Pilato, ngakhale Pilato anafuna kumusiya.
Munakana Woyera ndi Wolungama, namupempha Pilato kuti awaitane munthu wopherana.
Munapha mwini wa moyo, koma Mulungu anamuukitsa kwa akufa. Ife ndife mboni za ichi!
Kudzera m'chikhulupiriro m'dzina la Yesu, munthu uyu anapezeza chimake, monga mumuona ndi kumudziwa. Chikhulupiriro m'dzina lake chachiritsa munthu uyu patsogolo pa inu nonse.
"Abale, ndikudziwa kuti inu ndi otsogolera anu munachita izi m'kusadziwa kwanu.
Koma Mulungu anakwaniritsa zimene ananenera kwa mneneri onse, kuti Mesiya wake adzaumirira.
Choncho tembenukani mitima yanu mutembenukire Mulungu, kuti machimo anu achotsedwe.
Kenako nthawi za bwino zidzabwera kwa Ambuye, nadzatumizanso Yesu kwa inu, Mesiya wosankhidwa kwa inu.
Iye ayenera kukhala kumwamba mpaka nthawi ya kubwezeredwa kwa zinthu zonse, monga Mulungu ananena lino kale kudzera mwa aneneri ake oyera.
Mose anati, 'Ambuye Mulungu wanu adzakuutsani mneneri wofanana ndi ine kuchokera mwa abale anu. Imvani chilichonse chimene adzakuuzani.'
Ndipo Mose anati, 'Aliyense amene sadzamvera mneneri ameneyo adzachotsedwa m'gulu la Mulungu.'
Kuyambira Samueli, mneneri aliyense analankhula za masiku ano.
Inu ndinu ana a aneneri ndi pangano limene Mulungu analomezerana ndi makolo anu, akuuza Abrahamu, 'Kudzera m'zipatso zako mitundu yonse ya dziko lapansi idzadalitsidwa.'
Mulungu atatulutsa mtumiki wake Yesu, nayamba ndi inu anthu a Israeli, kutumizidwa kwa inu, ndalitseni potembenukitsa aliyense wa inu kuchokera ku njira zake zoyipa."
Pamene Petro ndi Yohane ankalankhula kwa anthu, ansembe, ndi mtsogoleri wa alonda a Kachisi, ndi aSaduki anabwera nawasokoneza.
Otsogolera awa anakhumudwa kwambiri kuti Petro ndi Yohane ankaphunzitsa anthu kuti kudzera mwa Yesu pali kuuka kwa akufa.
Anagwira iwo ndi, popeza kale kolimira, nawaimika m'ndende mpaka m'mawa.
Koma ambiri a amene anamva uthenga wao anakhulupirira, ndipo chiwerengero cha amuna anafikira pafupifupi mkwi asanu.
M'mawa mwake otsogolera, akuluakulu, ndi aphunzitsi a malamulo anasonkhana ku Yerusalemu.
Anasi mkulu wa ansembe anali kumeneko, pamodzi ndi Kayafa, ndi Yohane, ndi Alekisanda, ndi anzake onse a mkulu wa ansembe.
Anayimika ophunzira awiriwo pakati pawo, nafunsa, "Ndi mphamvu yanji, kapena dzina la ndani, mwachita ichi?"
Kenako Petro, wodzazidwa ndi Mzimu Woyera, anawauza, "Otsogolera ndi akuluakulu a anthu athu,
ngati lero tiyesedwa za ntchito yabwino yochitika kwa munthu wolema, akufuna kudziwa mmene anapezezedwa chiache,
dziwani nonse inu, ndi Israeli yonse, kuti munthu uyu waimirira pamaso panu ndi dzina la Yesu Khristu wa ku Nazareti, amene munamukometsera pa mtanda, koma Mulungu anamuukitsa kwa akufa.
Iye ndiye mwala umene inu omanga munaukana, wosanduka mwala wa ngodya.
Chipulumutso sichipezeka mwa wina aliyense! Mulungu sanapatseko dzina lina pansi pa thambo, limene tiyenera kupulumuka nalo."
Otsogolera a mpingo anasangalatika kuona kulimba mtima kwa Petro ndi Yohane, chifukwa anaona kuti anali anthu wamba opanda maphunziro a malembo. Nayalukira kuti anali ndi Yesu.
Koma akaona munthu wochiriridwa waimirira nao, sanakhalenso ndi chilichonse choti anene.
Choncho anawalamula achoke panja pa bwalo, nafunsa wina ndi mnzake.
Anati, "Tichite chiyani ndi anthu awa? Zizindikiro zankhondo zoonekeratu zachitika kudzera mwa iwo, ndipo anthu onse a ku Yerusalemu akuzidziwa.
Koma kuti izi zisachazike kwambiri pakati pa anthu, tiwachenjeze kuti asalankhule dzina la munthu uyu kwa aliyense."
Choncho anaitana atumwiwo, nawalamula kuti asalankhule kapena kuphunzitsa m'dzina la Yesu.
Koma Petro ndi Yohane anawayankha, "Murere kuti n'kolungama pamaso pa Mulungu kumvera inu osati Mulungu.
Sitingathe kusiya kulankhula za zimene taona ndi kumva."
Otsogolera anawachenjeza kwambiri, kenako anawasiya, chifukwa sanathe kuwapunisha chifukwa cha anthu, anthu onse anali kutamanda Mulungu
chifukwa cha zizindikiro zankhondo izi, kuchiritsa kwa munthu wolema kwa zaka poosa makumi anayi.
Atamasulidwa, Petro ndi Yohane anabwerera kwa okhulupirira anzawo, nanadziwitsa zonse zimene akulu a ansembe ndi akuluakulu anawauzira.
Amva izi, onse pamodzi anatulutsa mawu mapemphero kwa Mulungu, "Ambuye Wamphamvu Zonse, Mlengi wa thambo ndi dziko lapansi ndi nyanja ndi chilichonse chimene chili mmenemo,
inu munanena kudzera mu Mzimu Woyera, m'kamwa mwa mtumiki wanu Davide mkholo wathu, 'N'chifukwa chiyani mitundu inakwiya? N'chifukwa chiyani anthu analingalira zopanda ntchito?
Mafumu a dziko lapansi ankonzeka nzeru; olamulira anasonkhana pamodzi, motsutsana ndi Yehova ndi Mesiya wake.'

Izi zachitikadi m'mzinda uno! Herode Antipa ndi Pontiyo Pilato mabwanamkubwa, pamodzi ndi aGentaili ndi anthu a Israeli, anasonkhana pamodzi motsutsana ndi mtumiki wako woyera Yesu, amene munamozera mafuta.
Koma zonse anachita zinachitika malinga ndi chifuniro chanu chokonzedwa kale.
Ndipo tsopano, Ambuye, onani zowopseza zawo, natipatse ife atumiki anu kulimba mtima kolankhula mawu anu.
Tatambasulani dzanja lanu ndi mphamvu yochiritsa; ndipo zizindikiro zankhondo ndi zodabwitsa zichitike m'dzina la mtumiki wanu woyera Yesu."
Pamapeto pa pemphero ilo, malo amene anali kukumana anagwedezeka, onse anadzazidwa ndi Mzimu Woyera, nalankhula mawu a Mulungu ndi kulimba mtima.
Okhulupirira onse anali ndi mtima umodzi ndi maganizo amodzi. Palibe amene anati chinthu chilichonse chinachicha ndi chake, koma anakonzekera kugawana chilichonse chinali nawo.
Ndi mphamvu yaikulu atumwi anapereka umboni wa kuuka kwa Ambuye Yesu, ndipo chisomo chachikulu chinali pa iwo onse.
Palibe amene anali ndi nsangu pakati pawo, chifukwa amene anali ndi minda kapena nyumba anazigulitsa
nabweretsa ndalama kwa atumwi kuti agawane ndi amene anali ndi nsangu.
Yosefe, amene atumwi anamutcha Barnaba (kutanthauza, "Mwana wa Kulimbikitsa"), anali wa fuko la Alevi, nachokera pachilumba cha Kupro.
Anagulitsa munda wake, nabweretsa ndalama kwa atumwi.
Koma panali munthu wina dzina lake Ananiya, pamodzi ndi mkazi wake Safira, anagulitsa katundu wawo.
Anabisa gawo la ndalama, mkazi wake akudziwa, nabweretsa gawo lina kwa atumwi.
Kenako Petro anati, "Ananiya, n'chifukwa chiyani Satana wadzaza mtima wako kuti umbe Mzimu Woyera ndi kubisa gawo la ndalama za munda?
Usanaugulitsa, sinali wako? Nditaugulitsa, ndalama sizinali m'manja mwako? N'chifukwa chiyani munakonzera zinthu izi m'mitima yanu? Sunandiumba ife koma Mulungu!"
Ananiya amva mawu awa, agwa pansi, nafita. Mantha ukulu unagwira onse amene anamva za ichi.
Achichepere anaimirira, namupinda m'nsalu, namutulutsa, namulaza.
Pafupifupi maola atatu atangopita mkazi wake analowa, wosadziwa zimene zinachitika.
Petro anafunsa iye, "Muundikire ndikuuze, kodi ndalamazi ndi mtengo umene inu ndi mwamuna wanu munagulitsa munda?" Anayankha, "Inde, ndi mtengo umenewo."
Petro anati, "N'chifukwa chiyani inu awiri munagwirizana kuyesa Mzimu wa Ambuye? Onani, mapazi a amene analaza mwamuna wako ali pakhomo, nayenso akupita kukutulutsa iwe."
Nthawi yomweyo anagwa pansi pamapazi pa Petro, nafita. Achichepere analowa naona kuti anafa, namutulutsa, namulaza pambali pa mwamuna wake.
Mantha ukulu unagwira mpingo wonse ndi onse amene anamva za izi.
Atumwi anachita zizindikiro zankhondo ndi zodabwitsa zambiri pakati pa anthu. Okhulupirira onse anasonkhana nthawi zonse ku Gome la Solomoni m'Kachisi.
Koma palibe wina amene analimba mtima kulowa pakati pawo, ngakhale anthu onse anali kuwakuza.
Koma okhulupirira ena ndi ena, aamuna ndi amayi, anatsimikiziridwa ndi Ambuye, namuwongezera gulu.
Choncho anthu anabweretsa odwala m'misewu, nawayika pa mabedi ndi mphasa, kuti Petro akadutsa, thupi lake kachulo likhudze ena mwa iwo.
Zitso la anthu linabwera kuchokera m'mizinda yazungulira Yerusalemu, nachita nawo odwala ndi odankhidwa ndi mizimu yoyipa, ndipo onse anachiririka.
Kenako mkulu wa ansembe ndi aliyense wa ma ofisala ake, amene anali aSaduki, anadzazidwa ndi nsanje.
Anagwira atumwi nawayika m'ndende ya dziko lonse.
Koma mngelo wa Ambuye usiku unatsegula zitseko za ndende, nawatulutsa, kenako anawauza,
"Pitani ku Kachisi, muuze anthu uthenga wonse wa moyo uno!"

Atamva izi, m'mawa mwake analowa m'Kachisi nayamba kuphunzitsa. Mkulu wa ansembe ndi anzake anabwera, nasonkhana bwalo lalikulu la otsogolera, gulu lonse la akuluakulu a Israeli. Natumiza ku ndende kuti apite kukatenga atumwi.
Koma alonda a Kachisi atafika ku ndende sanawapereke. Anabwerera nati,
"Ndende inali ndi nsewu yotsekeredwa bwino, alonda aimirira pakhomo, koma tatsekulira, sinapezeka munthu!"
Mtsogoleri wa alonda a Kachisi ndi akulu a ansembe amva izi, analingalira bwino za ichi, ndi chimene chingachitike.
Kenako wina anabwera nawadziwitsa, "Amuna amene munawayika m'ndende ali m'Kachisi, ndi kuphunzitsa anthu!"
Mtsogoleri anapita ndi alonda ake, nawabweretsa atumwi, koma mopanda chipongwe, chifukwa anawopa kugonjedwa miyala ndi anthu.
Nabweretsa iwo patsogolo pa bwalo lalikulu, mkulu wa ansembe anawafunsa,
"Tinakuuzani molimba kuti musaphunzitse m'dzina la munthu uyu! Koma onani, mwadzaza Yerusalemu ndi chiphunzitso chanu, ndipo mukufuna kutichitira mlandu wa magazi a munthu uyu!"
Petro ndi atumwi anayankha, "Tiyenera kumvera Mulungu osati anthu.
Mulungu wa makolo athu anamuukitsa Yesu amene inu munapha pomukometsera pa mtanda.
Mulungu anamuikira malo a ulemu m'manja mwake lamanja ngati Mfumu ndi Mpulumutsi, kuti Israeli itembenuke mtima ndi kukhululukidwa machimo.
Ife ndife mboni za izi, ndi Mzimu Woyera amene Mulungu wapatsa onse amene amumvera."
Amva izi, bwalo linakasuka mtima, nali ndi maganizo owapha.
Koma mmodzi m'bwalo, wina Mfarisi dzina lake Gamaliyeli, wophunzira malamulo wakutemwa ndi anthu onse, anaimirira, nalamula kuti amuna aja atengedwe panja kwa kanthawi.
Kenako anauza anzake, "Amuna a Israeli, chenjerani zimene mukukonzera anthu awa!
Kale Teuda anabwera nai, nayerekeza kukhala wina wadzikulu. Pafupifupi amuna mazana anayi analondola, koma iye anapha, ndi onse amene anakhulupirira mwa iye anabalalika. Dongosolo lonse linatha.
Atatha iye, nthawi ya chiwerengero, Yuda wa ku Galileya anabwera nalondolola anthu. Nayenso atha, ndi onse amene analondola anabalalika.
Choncho tsopano, ndikunena, chokerani kwa amuna awa, ndimumasuleni. Ngati dongosolo ino ndi ntchito zao zachokera kwa anthu, lidzawonongedwa.
Koma ngati zachokera kwa Mulungu, simutha kuwonongetsa. Inde mungapeze kuti mukumenyeka ndi Mulungu!"
Anagwirizana naye. Anaitana atumwi, nawaswanya migoyo. Kenako anawalamula kuti asalankhule m'dzina la Yesu, nanawasulidwa.
Atumwi analawa patsogolo pa bwalo ndi chisangalalo, poona anawona oyenera kuponderezedwa chifukwa cha dzina la Yesu.
Tsiku ndi tsiku, m'Kachisi ndi m'nyumba, sanacha kuphunzitsa ndi kulengeza uthenga, "Yesu ndiye Mesiya."

M'masiku amenewa okhulupirira anaphuluphuka mwachangu, panabwera mkangano. Olankhula Chigriki anakwera kwa olankhula Chiheberi chifukwa akazi amasiye awo anachepetsedwa m'kugawana chakudya tsiku ndi tsiku.
Choncho Khumi ndi Awiri anaitana gulu lonse la okhulupirira. Anati, "Si bwino ife kusiya mawu a Mulungu kuti tisamalire zakudya.
Choncho abale, sankhani amuna asanu ndi awiri pakati panu amene akutemwa bwino ndi odzazidwa ndi Mzimu ndi nzeru. Tiwapatse gawo izi.
Ife tidzadzipereka ku mapemphero ndi utumiki wa mawu."

Maganizo awa anakondwetsa onse, nasankha awa: Stefano (wodzazidwa ndi chikhulupiriro ndi Mzimu Woyera), Filipo, Prokoro, Nikanora, Timoni, Parmena, ndi Nikolasi wa ku Antiokeya (wotebenukira chikhulupiriro cha chiYuda).
Iwo asanu ndi awiri anayimitsidwa patsogolo pa atumwi, amene anapempha naika manja awo pa iwo.
Choncho mawu a Mulungu anachazika. Chiwerengero cha ophunzira chinawonjezeka kwambiri ku Yerusalemu, ndi gulu lalikulu la ansembe anakhulupirira.
Stefano, wodzazidwa ndi chisomo cha Mulungu ndi mphamvu, anachita zodabwitsa ndi zizindikiro zankhondo pakati pa anthu.
Koma tsiku lina ena a sunagoge yotchedwa ya Amasulidwa anayamba kukangana naye. Anali aYuda a ku Kurene, ndi ku Alekisandiriya, ndi a ku Kilikiya, ndi a chigawo cha Asiya.
Sanakane nzeru ndi Mzimu umene Stefano ankuyankhula nawo.
Choncho ananyengerera amuna kuti anene bodza, "Tamumva akunyoza Mose, ndi Mulungu."
Izi zinasekamitsa anthu, akuluakulu, ndi aphunzitsi a malamulo. Anamugwira Stefano, nambweretsa patsogolo pa bwalo lalikulu.
Mboni zanama zinati, "Munthu uyu akunyoza Kachisi loyera ndi chilamulo cha Mose.
Tamumva akuti Yesu wa ku Nazareti adzawononga Kachisi ndi kusinthira miyambo imene Mose aatidzera."
Pa nthawi imeneyo onse okhala m'bwalo nayang'ana Stefano, ndikunaona nkhope yake ingati nkhope ya mngelo.
Kenako mkulu wa ansembe anafunsa, "Kodi izi n'zoona?"
Stefano anayankha, "Abale ndi atate, imvirani. Mulungu waulemerero anaonekera kwa mkholo wathu Abrahamu ali ku Mesopotamiya, asanakhale ku Harani.
Mulungu anauza, 'Choka m'dziko lako ndi mwa abale ako, upite ku dziko limene ndidzakuonetsa.'
Choncho Abrahamu anachoka m'dziko la aKaldaya, nakakhala ku Harani. Atamwalira abambo ake, Mulungu anamutulutsa, nabwera kuno ku dziko imwe mukukhala.
Koma Mulungu sanampase cholowa kuno, ngakhale phulo la mapazi. Koma anamulonjeza kuti dzikoli lidzakhala la iye ndi zipatso zake, ngakhale kuti pa nthawi imeneyo anali wopanda mwana.
Mulungu anamuzindikiritsa kuti zipatso zake zidzakhala alendo m'dziko lachilendo, ndipo anthu adzawapanga akapolo ndi kuwakandamitsa kwa zaka mazana anayi.
'Koma ndidzalanga mtundu amene adzawapanga akapolo,' Mulungu anati, 'ndipo adzatuluka nalambira ine m'malo ano.'

Mulungu anapatsa Abrahamu pangano la mdulidwe pa nthawi imeneyo. Choncho Abrahamu analera Isaki, namudulidwa pa tsiku lachisanu ndi chitatu. Isaki analera Yakobo, Yakobo analera mkholo khumi ndi awiri.
Mkholo uja anapsera Yosefe, namgulitsa kukhala kapolo ku Iguputo. Koma Mulungu anali naye
namumasula ku mavuto ake onse. Napatsa iye chisomo ndi nzeru pamaso pa Farao mfumu ya Iguputo, ndipo Farao anamuika bwanamkubwa wa Iguputo yonse ndi nyumba yake yonse.
Njala inagwera Iguputo ndi Kanani. Pakali pamene makolo athu sanatha kupeza chakudya.
Yakobo amva kuti panali tirigu ku Iguputo, natumiza makolo athu kuchita ulendo woyamba.
Pa ulendo wachiwiri, Yosefe anadziwika kwa abale ake, ndipo abale a Yosefe anadziwitsidwa kwa Farao.
Yosefe natumiza kuti abambo ake Yakobo abwere ndi abale ake onse, anthu makumi asanu ndi anayi ndi asanu.
Choncho Yakobo anatsikira ku Iguputo. Anafako, monga makolo athu anenso.
Matupi awo anatengedwa ku Sekemu naikidwa m'manda amene Abrahamu anagula ndi ndalama kuchokera kwa ana a Hamori ku Sekemu.
Nthawi ya kukwaniritsidwa kwa lonjezano limene Mulungu analonjeza Abrahamu litayandikira, anthu athu a ku Iguputo anachuluka kwambiri.
Mpaka mfumu ina inabwera pa mpando wa ufumu wa Iguputo imene sinadziwe za Yosefe.
Mfumu imeneyo inanyanyasira fuko lathu ndi kukandamitsa makolo athu, nawapanga abasiye mwana wao wamng'ono kuti afe.
Pa nthawi imeneyo Mose anabadwa, wokongola pamaso pa Mulungu. Anasamaliridwa m'nyumba kwa miyezi itatu.
Atabasiyidwa, mwana wa Farao anamtenga namchita mwana wake wokha.
Mose anaphunzitsidwa nzeru zonse za aIguputo, ndipo anali wamphamvu mu mawu ndi zochita.
Zaka makumi anayi atakwana, Mose anaganiza kukaona abale ake anthu a Israeli.
Anaona Mwiguputo akupondereza Myuda mmodzi. Anadutsa, nalimbikira Myuda uja, nachotsa mwizanu wake, napha Mwiguputo uja.
Mose ankaganiza kuti abale ake adzamvetsa kuti Mulungu anali kupereka chipulumutso kudzera mwa iye, koma sanamvetse.
M'mawa mwake anakaona amuna awiri a Israeli akukangana. Anayesa kuwayanjanitsa, "Amuna, ndinu abale. N'chifukwa chiyani mukuponderezana?"
Koma amene anali kuchimwa wina anakana Mose, "Ndani akuika iwe ngati mtsogoleri ndi woweruzira?
Ukufuna kundiphanso monga unapha Mwiguputo dzulo?"
Mose amva izi, anathawa, nakakhala mlendo m'dziko la Midiyani. Kumeneko analera ana ake awiri aamuna.
Zaka makumi anayi atatha, mngelo anaonekera kwa Mose m'chipululu pafupi ndi Phiri la Sinai, m'lawi la thengo loyaka moto.
Mose aona ichi, anasangalatika. Akayandikira kuti aone bwino, mawu a Yehova anabwera kwa iye,
'Ine ndine Mulungu wa makolo ako, Mulungu wa Abrahamu, ndi Isaki, ndi Yakobo.' Mose ananjenjemera sanadiritsire kuyang'ana.
Kenako Yehova anauza, 'Satsulani nsapato zanu, chifukwa malo amene muimirira ndi oyera.
Ndinaona kwambiri kuponderezedwa kwa anthu anga ku Iguputo. Namva kulira kwawo, natsikira kuwamasula. Tsopano bwera, nditumize iwe ku Iguputo.'

Mose ameneyu amene anakana, 'Ndani wakuika iwe ngati mtsogoleri ndi woweruzira?' anali amene Mulungu anatumiza ngati mtsogoleri ndi mpulumutsi, kudzera ndi mngelo amene anamuonekera m'thengo loyaka moto.
Ndi zizindikiro zankhondo ndi zodabwitsa, anatulutsa iwo ku Iguputo, ndi ku Nyanja Ilofiira, ndi m'chipululu kwa zaka makumi anayi.
Mose ameneyu anauza anthu a Israeli, 'Mulungu adzakuutsani mneneri wofanana ndi ine kuchokera mwa abale anu.'
Ameneyu anali pakati pa gulu m'chipululu pamodzi ndi makolo athu, ndi mngelo amene analankhula naye pa Phiri la Sinai. Nalandira mawu a moyo kupereka kwa ife.
Koma makolo athu sanafuna kumvera, namukanira. Mu mitima yawo, anafuna kubwerera ku Iguputo.
Anauza Aroni, 'Tipangire milungu yotsogolera ife, chifukwa Mose ameneyu anabweretsa ife ku Iguputo, sitidziwa zimene zachitikira iye.'
Pa nthawi imeneyo anapanga mfano wa ng'ombe, napereka nsembe kwa iye, nasangalala ndi ntchito ya manja awo.

Kenako Mulungu anatembenuka nawasiira napereka iwo ku utumiki wa nyenyezi za kumwamba! Monga zalembedwa m'buku la aneneri, 'Kodi munandiperekeratu nsembe ndi nsembe zaopsa mu zaka makumi anayi m'chipululu, Israeli?
Ai, munanyamula mkuwa wa Moleki ndi nyenyezi ya mulungu wanu Refani, ndi mafano amene munapanga kulambira. Choncho ndidzakutumizani m'uhambo kupitirira ku Babuloni.'
Makolo athu anali ndi hema la umboni m'chipululu. Iwo inalengedwa monga Mulungu anadongosola kwa Mose.
Makolo athu analitenga ndi Yosua m'nthawi imene anagonjetsa mitundu imene Mulungu anathamangitsa patsogolo pa makolo athu. Inakhala mpaka nthawi ya Mfumu Davide.
Davide anapeza chisomo pamaso pa Mulungu, napempha mwayi wopangira Mulungu wa Yakobo malo ake okhala.
Koma Solomoni ndiye amene anamangotsala akumangira.
Komabe Wamkulukulu Koposa Onse sakhala m'nyumba zimangidwa ndi manja a anthu. Monga mneneri akuti,
'Thambo ndi mpando wanga wachifumu, dziko lapansi ndi chopondapo mapazi anga. Kodi mungamangireni nyumba yanji? Ambuye akuti, kapena malo anji opumulira ine?
Kodi si ine amene manja anga anapanga zonse izi?'
"Inu ndimu onyada! Mitima ndi makutu anu adulidwa. Nthawi zonse mukukanira Mzimu Woyera! Monga makolo anu anachita, ndimomwemo ndi inu!
Ndi mneneri uyu umene makolo anu sanapondereze? Iwo nawaphapo amene ananeneratu kubwera kwa Wolungama, amene tsopano inu mnamupereka ndi kumpha.
Inu mwalandira chilamulo kudzera mwa mngelo koma simunasunga!"
Otsogolera a chiYuda amva izi, anakasuka mtima, namukukuta mano.
Koma Stefano, wodzazidwa ndi Mzimu Woyera, anayang'ana bwino kumwamba, naona ulemerero wa Mulungu, naona Yesu waimirira m'manja mwamanja a Mulungu.
Nati, "Onani, ndikuona thambo litsegulidwa, ndi Mwana wa Munthu waimirira m'manja mwamanja a Mulungu!"
Kenako anaphimba makutu awo ndi kuulula mawu mokweza. Anathamanga pamodzi
namukokera kunja kwa mzinda, nayamba kumugenda miyala. Ochichitira malo amnzawo anaika zovala zawo pa mapazi a mnyamata wina dzina lake Saulo.
Iwo akumugenda miyala, Stefano anapempha, "Ambuye Yesu, landira mzimu wanga."
Anagwada, nafuwula, "Ambuye, usawachemere machimo awa!" Atanena izi, anagona m'tulo ta imfa.

Saulo anali mmodzi wa mboni, nagwirizana ndi kuphawa kwa Stefano. Pa tsiku lomweli chikochiko chachikuru chinayamba ku mpingo wa ku Yerusalemu. Okhulupirira onse, kupatulapo atumwi, anabalalika ku zigawo za Yudeya ndi Samariya.
(Amuna ena odzipereka analaza Stefano namlira kwambiri.)
Koma Saulo anavunda mpingo. Analowa m'nyumba m'nyumba, nakoka aamuna ndi amayi, nawaika m'ndende.
Koma okhulupirira amene anabalalika analankhula uthenga wabwino wa Yesu kulikonse kumene anapita.
Filipo, mwachitsanzo, anapita ku mzinda wa Samariya, nalalikira anthu za Mesiya.
Anthu gulu linayandikira za zimene Filipo ankuuza, poimva ndi kuona zizindikiro zankhondo zimene anachita.
Mizimu yoyipa inatuluka, ikufuwula pamene iyala anthu. Ambiri amene anali cholephera ndi opanda mwendo anachiririka.
Choncho panali chisangalalo chachikuru m'mzinda umenewo.
Munthu wina dzina lake Simoni anali kale m'mzindamo, wachita ufiti nthawi yayitali, nasekamitsa anthu a Samariya nai ngati munthu wina wadzikulu.
Onse, kachichepere mpaka wakuluakulu, ankamutemera, anati, "Uyu ndiye Wamkulu, mphamvu ya Mulungu."
Ankamutemeradi chifukwa nthawi yayitali anasekamitsa iwo ndi ufiti wake.
Koma atakhulupirira Filipo polankhula za uthenga wabwino wa ufumu wa Mulungu ndi dzina la Yesu Khristu, aamuna ndi amayi anabatizidwa.
Simoni mwini anakhulupirira, nabatizidwa. Analondola Filipo kulikonse, nasangalatika ndi zizindikiro zankhondo ndi zodabwitsa zikulu zimene anaona.
Atumwi ku Yerusalemu amva kuti anthu a Samariya analandira mawu a Mulungu, natumiza Petro ndi Yohane kwa iwo.
Atafika, anapempha kuti okhulupirira atsopano alandire Mzimu Woyera.
Mzimu Woyera sanafike pa aliyense wa iwo, chifukwa anali abatizidwa m'dzina la Ambuye Yesu kokha.
Kenako Petro ndi Yohane anaika manja awo pa okhulupirira aja, nalandira Mzimu Woyera.
Simoni aona kuti Mzimu umaperededwa atumwi akaikira manja, nabwera kwa iwo ndi ndalama,
Nanena, "Ndipatsenso mphamvu imeneyi, kuti aliyense amene ndiikira manja alandire Mzimu Woyera!"
Koma Petro anayankha, "Ndalama zako ziwonongeke nawe chifukwa waganiza kuti mphatso ya Mulungu ingagulitsidwe!
Sunawe gawo kapena cholowa m'chinthu ichi, chifukwa mtima wako siwolungama pamaso pa Mulungu.
Tembenuka mtima ku choyipa chako ichi, upemphere Ambuye. Mwina adzakhululuka maganizo a mtima wako.
Chifukwa ndikuona kuti uli m'nkhanza yachichikwa ndi mkpanda wa tchimo."
Simoni anayankha, "Pemphererani Ambuye chifukwa changa, kuti chilichonse chimene mwanena chisandichitikire!"
Atatha kulamula umboni ndi kulankhula mawu a Ambuye ku Samariya, Petro ndi Yohane anabwerera ku Yerusalemu. Nalalikira uthenga wabwino m'midzi ingapo ya aSamariya m'njira.
Koma mngelo wa Ambuye anauza Filipo, "Imirira, upite kumpoto kwa njira ya chipululu yochokera ku Yerusalemu kupita ku Gaza."
Choncho anaimirira, napita. Anaona wosamalira chuma wa Etiopiya, nduna yaikulu yopanda mwambo pansiteredwe la mfumukazi ya Etiopiya yotchedwa Kandake. Anali kubwera ku Yerusalemu kulambira,
ndipo tsopano anali kubwerera. Anakhala pa galeta lake, nakuwerengera buku la mneneri Isaya.
Mzimu Woyera anauza Filipo, "Danda mayandikire galeta ilo."
Filipo anadutsa mwachangu, namva munthu uja akuwerengera buku la mneneri Isaya. Filipo anafunsa, "Kodi mumvetsera zimene mukuwerengera?"
Anayankha, "N'mmene ndingamvetserere bwanji, popanda wondiphunzitsa?" Napempha Filipo kuti akwere galeta nakhale naye.

Gawo la Malemba limene ankuwerengera linali ichi, "Anatengedwa ngati nkhosa kupita kuchinjiriro. Ngati mwana wankhosa amakhalira chete pamaso pa amene akummetula uboya wake, sanatsekulire pakamwa pake.
M'chipondomelo chake chilungamo chinachotsedwa kwa iye. Ndani akanena za mibadwo yake? Chifukwa moyo wake unachotsedwa m'dziko lapansi."
Wosamalira chuma anafunsa Filipo, "Ndiuzeni, kodi mneneri akunena ichi za iye mwini kapena wina aliyense?"
Kenako Filipo anayamba ndi Malemba amenewo namuuza uthenga wabwino wa Yesu.
Akiyenda, anabwera kwa madzi ena, ndipo wosamalira chuma anati, "Taonani! Pali madzi. N'chiyani chindiletsa kubatizidwa?"
Analamula galeta laimirire, iwo awiri analowa m'madzi, Filipo namubatiza.
Atuluka m'madzi, Mzimu wa Ambuye anatengera Filipo mwachangu. Wosamalira chuma sanamuoneso, koma anapitirira njira yake ndi chisangalalo.
Filipo anapeza iye wokhawo ku mzinda wa Azoto. Nalalikira uthenga wabwino m'mzindawo ndi kulikonse mpaka anafika ku Kaisariya.
Saulo anali nthawi zonse akulakaraka ndi kuopseza ophunzira a Ambuye. Anapita kwa mkulu wa ansembe,
napempha makalata kwa sunagoge za ku Damasiko, kuti ngati asangane ndi amene anali otsata Njira, aamuna kapena amayi, abwebweze iwo ku Yerusalemu m'maunyolo.
Akiyenda, pafupi ndi Damasiko, mwamsanga kuwala kwa kumwamba kunawazingulira.
Anagwa pansi, namva mawu akumuuza, "Saulo, Saulo, n'chifukwa chiyani ukundiutsa?"
Anafunsa, "Ndinu ndani, Ambuye?" Anayankha, "Ndine Yesu amene ukundimenyera!
Koma imirira ulowe m'mzinda, udzauziridwa zimene uyenera kuchita."
Amuna amene ankayenda naye anaimirira mosalankhula, amva mawu koma saona munthu.
Saulo anaimirira pansi, koma atatsegula maso ake anali wosadziwona. Namutsogolera ndi dzanja mpaka ku Damasiko.
Anakhala wosaona kwa masiku atatu, nadya kanthu kapena kumwa.
Tsopano panali mkhulupiriri ku Damasiko dzina lake Ananiya. Ambuye anamulankhula mu masomphenya, "Ananiya!" Anayankha, "Inde, Ambuye!"
Ambuye anati, "Imirira, upite ku msewu wotchedwa Wowongoka, ku nyumba ya Yuda. Upemphere munthu wa ku Tariso dzina lake Saulo, chifukwa akupemphera kwa ine hano.
Namuonetsa masomphenya a munthu dzina lake Ananiya walowa namuika manja kuti aonekenso."
Koma Ananiya anayankha, "Ambuye, ndamva za anthu ambiri mwachimene munthu uyu anachitira okhulupirira ku Yerusalemu!
Ndipo apa anali ndi ulamuliro wochokera kwa akulu a ansembe kugwira onse amene amatcha dzina lanu."
Koma Ambuye anati, "Pita, chifukwa Saulo ndi chida chosankhidwa ndi ine kuti anyamule dzina langa pamaso pa aGentaili ndi mafumu, ndi anthu a Israeli.
Ndimuonetsa chomene chake kuyenera kumva chifukwa cha dzina langa."

Choncho Ananiya anapita nakamupeza Saulo. Anaika manja ake pa iye, nati, "Mng'ono Saulo, Ambuye Yesu amene anaonekera kwa iwe pa njira umene ubwera wandituma kuti iwe uonenso nadzazidwe ndi Mzimu Woyera."
Nthawi yomweyo zinthu ngati nzayi zinagwa pa maso ake, naonanso. Anaimirira nabatizidwa.
Kenako anadya chakudya nakhazika mphamvu. Saulo anakhala ndi okhulupirira ku Damasiko kwa masiku angapo.
Nthawi yomweyo anayamba kulalikira za Yesu m'masinagoge, akuuza, "Iye ndiye Mwana wa Mulungu!"

Onse amene anamva anasangalatika, nafunsa, "Kodi si ameneyu amene anayipanikiza ku Yerusalemu amene ankachitira zipanikizo anthu amene atchulidwa m'dzina ilo? Ndipo anabwera kuno kuti awakoke m'maunyolo ndi kuwapeleka kwa akulu a ansembe?"
Koma Saulo analimba ndi kuwonjezeka mphamvu, nafunditsa aYuda okhala ku Damasiko, naonetsa kuti Yesu ndiye Mesiya.
Masiku angapo atapita, aYuda anakonza njira yomphana.
Anali asamala pa mtseko wa mzinda usana ndi usiku kuti amuphe, koma Saulo anamva za mgwirizano wawo.
Choncho ophunzira ena analowa usiku, namtsitsa m'dengu lakulu kupyola khoma la mzinda.
Saulo atafika ku Yerusalemu, anayesa kulumikizana ndi ophunzira, koma onse anamopa. Sanakhulupirire kuti anasanduka mkhulupiriri.

Koma Barnaba anatenga Saulo, nabweretsa kwa atumwi. Anawafotokozereza mmene Saulo anaona Ambuye pa njira, ndi mmene Ambuye analankhula naye, ndi mmene Saulo analimbika m'kulalikira m'dzina la Yesu ku Damasiko.
Choncho Saulo anakhala ndi atumwi, nyenda ndi kunyendera onse ku Yerusalemu, akulalikira molimba m'dzina la Ambuye.
Anakangana ndi aYuda olankhula Chigriki, koma iwo anayesetsa kumpha.
Abale amva izi, anampeleka ku Kaisariya, namtumiza ku Tariso.
Kenako mpingo unakhala m'bata mu Yudeya yonse, ndi Galileya, ndi Samariya, nawolola ndi kulimba m'kuopa Ambuye. Ndi chithandizo cha Mzimu Woyera, unawonjezera chiwerengero chake.
Petro akuyendayenda m'mmalo onse, anatsikira okhulupirira okhala ku Luda.
Kumeneko anapeza munthu wina dzina lake Ainiya, amene anali wogona pa bedi zaka zisanu ndi zitatu, wopanda mphamvu.
Petro anauza, "Ainiya, Yesu Khristu akuchiritsa! Imirira, ukonze bedi lako!" Nthawi yomweyo anaimirira.
Anthu onse okhala ku Luda ndi ku Saroni anaona Ainiya, natembenukira Ambuye.
Ku Yopa panali mkhulupiriri dzina lake Tabita (m'Chigriki amatcha Dorika). Anali nthawi zonse kuchita zabwino ndi kuthandiza osauka.
Pa nthawi imeneyo anakalamba nadwala. Anafa. Anasamba thupi lake naikidwa m'chipinda chamwamba.
Koma ophunzira amva kuti Petro anali ku Luda pafupi, natumiza amuna awiri kumuuza, "Chonde tiyani msanga!"

Choncho Petro anaimirira naenda nawo. Atafika, anamupeleka ku chipinda chamwamba. Chipindacho chinali chodzazidwa ndi akazi amasiye akupsa misozi, naonetsa zovala ndi zofewa zimene Dorika anapanga ali moyo.
Koma Petro anawaotcha onse panja, nagwada napempha. Anatembenukira thupi lija, nati, "Tabita, imirira." Anatsegula maso, naona Petro, nakhala.
Petro anamupatsa dzanja namuthandiza kaimirira. Kenako anaitana akazi amasiye ndi okhulupirira onse, nawaonetsa ali moyo.
Uthenga unazika mu mzinda wonse, ambiri anakhulupirira Ambuye.
Petro anakhala nthawi yayitali ku Yopa kwa Simoni mchema wa zikopa.
Ku Kaisariya panali mkondo wa aRoma dzina lake Korneliyo, mtsogoleri wa gulu lotchedwa la Italia.
Anali wokhulupirika naopa Mulungu, pamodzi ndi nyumba yake yonse. Anapatsa omangidwa ndi nsanje zambiri, napempha Mulungu nthawi zonse.
Pa tsiku lina pafupifupi nthawi ya tatu masana, anaona m'masomphenya mngelo wa Mulungu wabwera kwa iye, wamulangiza, "Korneliyo!"
Korneliyo anamuyang'ana ndi mantha, nafunsa, "Kodi n'chiyani, Ambuye?" Mngelo anayankha, "Mapemphero ako ndi mphatso zako kwa osauka zapita kwa Mulungu ngati nsembe!
Tsopano tumiza anthu ku Yopa, ukaitane munthu wina dzina lake Simoni Petro.
Akukhala kwa Simoni mchema wa zikopa, yemwe nyumba yake ili pafupi ndi nyanja."
Mngelo atachoka, Korneliyo anaitana atumiki awiri a nyumba yake ndi msilikali woopa Mulungu mmodzi wa akapolo ake.
Anawafotokozera za izi, nanatumiza ku Yopa.
M'mawa wake anthu aja akiyandikira mzinda, Petro anakwera pa denga lolimba kuti apemphe. Anali pafupifupi nthawi ya masana,
nadwala njala. Chakudya chikukonzedwa, analowa mu msinkho.
Anaona thambo litsegulidwa ndi chinthu china ngati chingwe chachikulu cholowetsedwa ndi msonga yake inayi kuchokera kumwamba.
M'menemo munali nyama zopanda nkhuwu ndi machela onse ndi mbalame za kumwamba.
Mawu anafika kwa iye, "Imirira, Petro, ukapha nudya!"
Koma Petro anati, "Ayi, Ambuye! Sindinakhale ine kudya chinthu chilichonse chongola kapena chosayeretsedwa m'malamulo athu."
Mawu anabweranso kachiwiri, "Usatche chosayeretsedwa chimene Mulungu wachiyeretsa."
Izi zinachitika katatu, kenako chingwe chija chinabwezeredwa kumwamba mwachangu.
Petro ankalingalira bwino mosomphenya aja chinatanthauza chiyani, anthu atumizidwa ndi Korneliyo anafika pa nyumba ya Simoni, naimirira pakhomo.
Nafunsa ngati Simoni wotchedwa Petro akukhalako.
Petro akulingalira za mosomphenya, Mzimu Woyera anati kwa iye, "Taona, amuna atatu akukukefula.
Imirira tsikira, upite nawo mosakaika. Chifukwa ndine wawatuma iwo."
Choncho Petro anatsikira, nauza amuna aja, "Ndine amene mukumufuna. Bweretsaniku chifukwa chiyani?"
Anati, "Tinatumizidwa ndi Korneliyo, mkondo wa aRoma. Ndi munthu wambiri nzeru ndi woopa Mulungu, watemwedwa ndi aYuda onse. Mngelo woyera wamuuza kukuitana kwa nyumba yake kuti amve mawu a Ambuye."
Choncho Petro anawaitana kulowa, naakasiyo usiku. M'mawa wake anaimirira ndi iwo, amene abale ena a ku Yopa anapita naye.
Tsiku lotsatira anafika ku Kaisariya. Korneliyo anali adikirira iwo, anasonkhanitsa abale ake ndi a ndzace apamtima.
Petro akalowa, Korneliyo anagwera pa mapazi ake namtamanda.
Koma Petro anamyamula, nati, "Imirira! Nayenso ndine munthu."
Ndi kuyankhulana, analowa, napeza anthu ambiri onsonkhana.
Petro anawauza, "Inu mukudziwa kuti n'kulekana ndi malamulo kwa Myuda kulowa kwa Mgentaili kapena kukumana naye. Koma Mulungu wandionetsa kuti nthu aliyense asatchidwe wongola kapena wosayeretsedwa.
Choncho ndinabwera mosakaika atanditumiza. Tsopano ndiuzeni n'chifukwa chiyani mwanditumiza."
Korneliyo anayankha, "Masiku anayi apita ine ndi kupempha m'nyumba yanga pa nthawi imeneyi ya tatu masana. Mwamsanga, munthu wa zovala zowala anaimirira patsogolo panga.
Nanena, 'Korneliyo, pemphero lako lamveka, ndi mphatso zako kwa osauka zakumbukidwa ndi Mulungu!
Tsopano tumiza anthu ku Yopa, ukaitane Simoni wotchedwa Petro. Akukhala m'nyumba ya Simoni mchema wa zikopa, pafupi ndi nyanja.'
Choncho ndakutumizira msanga, ndipo unachita bwino kubwera. Tsopano tonsefe tili pano pamaso pa Mulungu kuti timve chilichonse chimene Ambuye wakuuza iwe."
Kenako Petro anauza, "Ndikuwona bwino kuti Mulungu sakhudzukhudza nkhope.
M'mtundu ulifonse, aliyense woopa Mulungu ndi kuchita chilungamo alandirirwa naye.
Uyu ndiye uthenga wabwino wa mtendere kudzera mwa Yesu Khristu, amene ndi Ambuye wa onse, amene Mulungu anautumiza kwa anthu a Israeli.
Mukudziwa zimene zinachitika mu Yudeya yonse, kuyambira ku Galileya, atangoyamba Yohane kulalikira za ubatizo.
Mukudziwa mmene Mulungu anadzoza Yesu wa ku Nazareti ndi Mzimu Woyera ndi mphamvu, ndipo Yesu anayenda kuchita zabwino ndi kuchiritsa onse oponderezedwa ndi mdierekezi, chifukwa Mulungu anali naye.
Ife tiri mboni za zonse zimene anachita mu Yudeya ndi ku Yerusalemu. Anamupha ndi kumukometsera pa mtanda,
koma Mulungu anamuukitsa pa tsiku lachitatu, namupatsa kuonekera,
osati kwa anthu onse, koma kwa ife amene Mulungu anasankhira kuti tikhale mboni. Ife tinkadya ndi kumwa naye ataukitsa kwa akufa.
Natulamula tilalikire kwa onse ndi kulankhula umboni kuti ndiye amene Mulungu wamuika kukhala woweruza wa amoyo ndi akufa.
Iye ndiye amene aneneri onse analankhula za iye, kuti aliyense amene amkhulupirira adzalandira kukhululukidwa kwa machimo kudzera mu dzina lake."
Petro akuyankhula mawu awa, Mzimu Woyera anagwa pa onse amene ankumvetsera uthenga.
Okhulupirira a chiYuda amene anabwera ndi Petro anasangalatika kuti mphatso ya Mzimu Woyera ithiriridwa nayenso pa aGentaili.
Chifukwa anamva akuyankhula zilankhulo zina ndi kutamanda Mulungu. Kenako Petro anafunsa,
"Kodi aliyense angathe kukaniza kubatizidwa kwa iwo ndi madzi, popeza iwo analandira Mzimu Woyera monga ife tinalandira?"
Choncho analamula kubatizidwa m'dzina la Yesu Khristu. Kenako Korneliyo anampempha kukhala nao masiku angapo.
Atumwi ndi okhulupirira mu Yudeya anamva kuti aGentaili nawo analandira mawu a Mulungu.
Koma Petro atabwerera ku Yerusalemu, okhulupirira a chiYuda anamugwetsa mlandu,
nanena, "Unalowa nyumba ya anthu odulidwa usipo ndi kudya nawo!"
Kenako Petro anawafotokozera momwe zonse zinachitikira:

"Ndinali m'mzinda wa Yopa ndikupempha, ndinalowa mu msinkho, ndinaona mosomphenya. Chinthu china ngati chingwe chachikulu cholowetsedwa ndi msonga yake inayi chinatsika kuchokera kumwamba, chinabwera mpaka kwa ine.
Nditayangalika m'menemo ndinaona nyama zachilengedwe ndi za m'tchire, machela, ndi mbalame za kumwamba.
Namva mawu akuuza, 'Imirira, Petro, ukapha nudya!'
Ndinanena, 'Ayi, Ambuye! Chinthu cha ngola kapena chosayeretsedwa sindinakhale nchidya m'kamwa mwanga.'
Koma mawu anabwera kachiwiri kuchokera kumwamba, 'Usatche wosayeretsedwa zimene Mulungu waziyeretsa.'
Izi zinachitika katatu, kenako chilichonse chinabukapo kumwamba.
Mwamsanga amuna atatu atumizidwa kuchokera ku Kaisariya anafika pa nyumba imene tikukhala.
Mzimu Woyera anauza kuti ndipite nawo mosakaika. Abale awa asanu ndi mmodzi anapita ndinawo, nalowa nyumba ya munthu amene watiuma.
Anatiuza mmene mngelo anaonekera m'nyumba yake namuuza, 'Tumiza anthu ku Yopa, ukaitane Simoni wotchedwa Petro.
Iye adzakuuza mmene iwe ndi nyumba yako yonse mupulumukire!'
Ndiyamba kulankhula, Mzimu Woyera anagwa pa iwo monga anagwira pa ife pa chiyambi.
Ndipo ndinakumbuka mawu a Ambuye mmene anati, 'Yohane anabatiza ndi madzi, koma inu mudzabatizidwa ndi Mzimu Woyera.'
Choncho Mulungu atawapatsa mphatso imeneyo yomweyo anatipatse ife atamukhulupirira Ambuye Yesu Khristu, ndine ndani kuti ndizokonzere Mulungu?"
Amva izi, anasiya kulimbikira nanena, "Choncho Mulungu nawapatsa aGentaili mwayi wotembenuka mtima kupezeka moyo wosatha."
Okhulupirira amene anabalalika chifukwa cha chikochiko cha nthawi ya imfa ya Stefano anapita mpaka ku Foinike, ndi Kupro, ndi ku Antiokeya wa Suriya. Analalikira mawu kwa aYuda okha.
Koma ena a okhulupirira amene anabwera ku Antiokeya ochokera ku Kupro ndi ku Kurene anayamba kulankhula kwa aGentaili za Ambuye Yesu.
Mphamvu ya Ambuye inali nawo, chiwerengero chachikuru cha aGentaili anakhulupirira natembenukira Ambuye.
Uthenga wa izi unafika kwa mpingo wa ku Yerusalemu, natumiza Barnaba ku Antiokeya.
Atafika naona umboni wa madalitso a Mulungu, anakondwa nawoimbira okhulupirira kuti akhazikike ndi mtima wonse kwa Ambuye.
Barnaba anali munthu wabwino, wodzazidwa ndi Mzimu Woyera ndi chikhulupiriro. Ndipo anthu ambiri analumikizidwa ndi Ambuye.
Kenako Barnaba anapita ku Tariso kukafuna Saulo.
Atamupeza, anabweretsa ku Antiokeya. Onse awiri anakhala ndi mpingo chaka chathunthu, naphunzitsa anthu ochuluka. (Anali ku Antiokeya kuti ophunzira anayamba kutchedwa aKhristu.)
M'masiku amenewa, aneneri anabwera kuchokera ku Yerusalemu ku Antiokeya.
Mmodzi wa iwo dzina lake Agabo anaimirira m'msonkhano umodzi, nananeza ndi Mzimu kuti njala yaikulu idzabwera pa dziko lonse la Roma. (Izi zinakwaniritsidwa pa nthawi ya ulamuliro wa Klaudio.)
Choncho okhulupirira ku Antiokeya anasankha kutumiza thandizo kwa abale okhala ku Yudeya, aliyense ndi malipiro monga angathe.
Zinachita motero, nazitumiza ndi Barnaba ndi Saulo kwa akuluakulu a mpingo ku Yerusalemu.
Mu nthawi imeneyo Mfumu Herode Agripa anayamba kuutsa mwachipongwe okhulupirira ena a mpingo.
Anampha mtumwi Yakobo, mng'ono wa Yohane, ndi lupanga.
Aona kuti zinakondweretsa aYuda, anaganizira kugwira nayenso Petro. (Ichi chinachitika pa Pasaka.)
Atamgwira, anamika m'ndende, namukabika kwa agalamukizi ana anayi mwa ana anayi. Herode anafuna kumuwonetsera anthu atatha Pasaka.
Koma Petro ali m'ndende, mpingo unkapemphera mwamphamvu kwambiri kwa Mulungu chifukwa chake.
Usiku umene Herode anali kumuwonetsera Petro, anali agona, wamangidwa ndi maunyolo awiri pakati pa asilikali awiri. Alonda ankodza pa khomo la ndende.
Mwamsanga kuwala kwakukulu kunabwera m'chipinda, ndi mngelo wa Ambuye anaimirira pafupi ndi Petro. Mngelo anamukomesha m'mbali, namunyamula, "Msanga, imirira!" Maunyolo anagwera pa manja ake.
Kenako mngelo anauza, "Viikeni zovala zako ndi nsapato zako." Anachita momwemo. Nanena, "Viikani chovala chako chachikulu, unditsatire."
Choncho Petro anatuluka namutsata, koma ankagona kuti ichi chinali mosomphenya. Sanadziwire kuti zinali zochitika zenizeni.
Anadutsa alonda oyamba ndi achiwiri, nafika pa khomo la chitsulo lolowera ku mzinda, linatsegulidwa tokha. Anatuluka nalowa m'msewu, ndipo mngelo anamusiira mwachangu.
Petro anabwerera pa maganizo ake, nati, "Ndikudziwa tsopano kuti n'zoona zeni zeni! Ambuye watumiza mngelo wake, namasula ine kwa Herode ndi za zonse zimene aYuda ankakonzera ine!"
Atazindikira izi, anapita ku nyumba ya Mariya, amayi a Yohane Maliko, kumene anthu ambiri anali osonkhana kupemphera.
Anagogoda pa khomo la chipata, mnyamata wamkazi dzina lake Roda anabwera kufungula.
Anadziwa mawu a Petro, nasangalala kwambiri kuti, m'malo mwa kufungula khomo, anadutsa m'nyumba naulula kwa onse, "Petro waimirira pa khomo!"
Anati, "Mwatuluka nawo!" Atakakakiza, anasankha, "N'mngelo wake."
Petro anali nthawi zonse akugogoda. Atsegula khomo naona iye, nasangalatika.
Anawapempha agone, nawawuza mmene Ambuye anamutulutsa m'ndende. "Dziwitsa Yakobo ndi abale," anati. Kenako anachoka napita kwina.
M'mawa mwake panabwera mkangano waukulu pakati pa asilikali pa zimene zinachitika ndi Petro.
Herode Agripa anafuna iye mwa kuyendayenda, asanamupeze. Anamfunsa alonda nawachita mlandu, nawalamula aphedwe. Kenako Herode anachoka ku Yudeya, nakakhala ku Kaisariya kwa kanthawi.

Herode anali ndi mkasukwa ndi anthu a ku Tiro ndi Sidoni. Choncho anatumiza uthenga kwa iye chifukwa mizinda yawo inalakanitsa chakudya chochokera m'dziko la Herode. Anathandizidwa ndi Blasito, wosamalira chipinda cha Herode,
ndinapangika kuti aone Herode. Pa tsiku loikidwa, Herode anafika avala zovala zake zachifumu, nakakhala pa mpando wake wachifumu, nalankhula nawo.
Anthu anamupatsa chisangalalo chachikuru, nafuwula, "Uyu n'mawu a mulungu, osati a munthu!"
Nthawi yomweyo mngelo wa Ambuye anamukome ndi matenda, chifukwa sanapatse Mulungu ulemerero. Napha ndi nyerere, nafita.
Koma mawu a Mulungu anachazika nawolola, chiwerengero cha okhulupirira chinawonjezeka.
Barnaba ndi Saulo atamaliza utumiki wawo ku Yerusalemu, anabwerera, natenga Yohane wotchedwa Maliko.
Pakati pa aneneri ndi aphunzitsi a mpingo wa ku Antiokeya wa Suriya panali Barnaba, Simeoni wotchedwa Wakuda, Lukiyo wa ku Kurene, Manayeni (mzake wa Mfumu Herode Antipa kuyambira ubwana), ndi Saulo.
Tsiku lina akulamulaawa akalambira Ambuye ndi kusala chakudya, Mzimu Woyera anati, "Anditsetsani Barnaba ndi Saulo ku ntchito yomwe ndawaitanira."
Choncho atasala chakudya ndi kupemphera kwina, anaika manja awo pa iwo, nawatumiza.
Choncho Barnaba ndi Saulo, atumizidwa ndi Mzimu Woyera, anatsikira ku Selewukiya, kachitiro ka nyanja, kenako anayendanso nyanja kupita ku Kupro.
Kufika ku Salamisi, analengeza mawu a Mulungu m'masinagoge a aYuda. Yohane Maliko anapita nawo kukhala mthandizi wawo.
Anayenda mu chilumba chonse mpaka ku Pafo, kumene anapeza Myuda wina wachifiti, mneneri wabodza, dzina lake Bariyesu.
Anali ndi mgwirizano ndi bwanamkubwa Sergiyasi Paulosi, munthu wa nzeru. Bwanamkubwa anaitana Barnaba ndi Saulo, chifuniro chake chimva mawu a Mulungu.
Koma Elima mchifiti (kutanthauza dzina lake m'Chigriki) anawakana, poyesetsa kusokoneza chikhulupiriro cha bwanamkubwa.
Kenako Saulo, wotchedwa nayenso Paulo, wodzazidwa ndi Mzimu Woyera, anamuyang'ana maso pa maso,
nati, "Iwe mwana wa mdierekezi, wadzazidwa ndi chinyengo ndi chisokonezo chonse, mdani wa chilungamo chonse! Sucha kugwedeza njira zoongoka za Ambuye?
Tsopano, taona, dzanja la Ambuye likubwera pa iwe, udzakhala wosaona dzuwa kwa kanthawi." Mwamsanga mdima nagwa pa maso ake, nafunafuna munthu wa kumugwira dzanja namtsogolere.
Bwanamkubwa aona ichi, anakhulupirira, nasangalatika kwambiri ndi chiphunzitso cha Ambuye.
Paulo ndi anzake anatuluka ku Pafo ndi bwato napita ku Pamfiliya, kukachitiro ka Perga. Kumeneko Yohane Maliko anawasiya nabwerera ku Yerusalemu.
Koma Paulo ndi Barnaba anayenda m'dziko, nafika ku Antiokeya wa Pisidiya. Pa Sabata analowa m'sunagoge nakakhala.
Atangomalizika kuwerenga m'buku la Mose ndi m'buku la aneneri, otsogolera a sunagoge natumiza kwa iwo uthenga, "Abale, ngati muli ndi mawu olutsitsa mtima kwa anthu, yambani kunena."
Choncho Paulo anaimirira, nakweza dzanja lake kuti agone, nayamba kulankhula, "Anthu a Israeli, ndi inu aGentaili woopa Mulungu, imvirani.
Mulungu wa Israel anasankha makolo athu nawakulitsa pamene anali amlendo ku Iguputo, ndipo ndi dzanja lolimba anawatulutsa m'ukapolo.
Anabalalika nawo m'chipululu kwa zaka makumi anayi.
Ndipo anagonjetsa mitundu isanu ndi iwiri ku Kanani nawapatsa dziko lawo ngati cholowa.
Izi zinachitika zaka mazana anayi ndi makumi asanu. Kenako anawapatsa oweruza mpaka nthawi ya mneneri Samueli.
Kenako anthu anafunafuna mfumu, Mulungu anawapa Saulo mwana wa Kisi, wa fuko la Benjamini, amene analamulira zaka makumi anayi.
Koma Mulungu anamsiya Saulo, namsandutsa Davide, wa amene Mulungu anati, 'Ndapeza Davide mwana wa Yese, munthu wofunikira mtima wanga, amene adzachita chilichonse chimene ndifuna.'
Kuchokera m'zipatso za Davide, Mulungu anabweretsa Israeli Mpulumutsi, Yesu, monga analonjeza.
Yohane Mbatizi analengeza kuchokera pa chiyambi cha utumiki wake kwa Israeli yonse kuti atembenuke mtima ndi kubatizidwa.
Yohane akumalizira utumiki wake, anafunsa, "Kodi inu mukundikhulupirira kuti ndine Mesiya? Ai, sindine! Koma iye wobwera m'tsogolo mwanga, sindiyenera ngakhale kumasula nsapato za mapazi ake.'
Abale, inu mwana wa Abrahamu, ndi inu aGentaili woopa Mulungu, uthenga wa chipulumutso watumizidwa kwa ife!
Anthu a ku Yerusalemu ndi otsogolera awo sanamudziwe, koma namuweruza, nakwaniritsa mawu a aneneri amene amawerenga pa Sabata iliyonse.
Ngakhale kuti sanasangane ndi chifukwa chilichonse chobweretsa imfa, anapempha Pilato kuti aphedwe.
Atakwaniritsa zonse zimene zinalembedwa za iye, anammeta pa mtanda, namuika m'manda.
Koma Mulungu anamuukitsa kwa akufa!
Anaonekera kwa ambiri amene anapita naye kuchokera ku Galileya ku Yerusalemu. Iwo tsopano ndi mboni zake kwa anthu a Israeli.
Ndipo ife tili pano kukulalikira uthenga wabwino, lonjezano limene linachitika kwa makolo athu,
Mulungu walimazirira kwa ife, ana awo, poukitsa Yesu. Monga Salimo lachiwiri linanena za Yesu, 'Iwe ndiye Mwana wanga. Lero ndalidwa abambo ako.'
Mulungu analonjeza kumuukitsa kwa akufa, osam'siya kusola m'manda. Anati, 'Ndidzakupatsa madalitso oyera amene ndalolnjeza Davide.'
Ndipo Salimo lina linanena bwino, 'Sudzalosera Woyera wako kusola.'
Koma Davide asakazidwadi wake dziko lake, nafita nabatizidwa ndi makolo ake, thupi lake linasola.
Koma amene Mulungu anamuukitsa thupi lake silinasole.
Abale, imvirani! Kudzera mwa Yesu ameneyu, tinalengeza kwa inu kukhululukidwa kwa machimo.
Aliyense amene amkhulupirira iye amachitidwa chilungamo pamaso pa Mulungu, chilichonse chimene chilamulo cha Mose sichinathe kuchita.
Chenjani kuti mawu a aneneri asagwere pa inu:
'Taonani, inu ochita chipongwe, sangalatikani ndi kumfa! Chifukwa nkuchita ntchito m'masiku anu, yomwe simudzaikhulupirira ngakhale wina akuuzani.'"
Paulo ndi Barnaba atachoka m'sunagoge tsiku lomwe, anthu anawapempha kuyankhula za izi Sabata yotsatira.
Asinagoge atatasalatsa, aYuda ambiri ndi olembedwa oopa Mulungu anapita nawo Paulo ndi Barnaba, awiriwo naulimbikitsa kumanga chiyembekezo pa chisomo cha Mulungu.
Sabata yotsatira, mzinda wonse pafupifupi unabwera kumva mawu a Ambuye.
Koma aYuda aona magulu, anadzazidwa ndi nsanje, nanena zoipa motsutsana ndi Paulo.

Kenako Paulo ndi Barnaba analimba mtima nanena, "Chinayenera kwambiri kuti mawu a Mulungu alankhulidwe kwa inu aYuda choyamba. Koma popeza mukakana ndi kuyerekeza nokha osayenera moyo wosatha, tiuza aGentaili.
Chifukwa Ambuye watilamula motero, 'Ndakusankhani kukhala kuwala kwa aGentaili, kuti mubweretse chipulumutso kumalekezero a dziko lapansi.'"
AkuGentaili amva izi, nasangalala, natamanda mawu a Ambuye; ndipo onse osankhidwa moyo wosatha anakhulupirira.
Choncho mawu a Ambuye anazika mu chigawo chonse chimene chinali.
Koma aYuda anakutsidwa amayi odziwika oopa Mulungu ndi otsogolera a mzinda, natukutuka chikochiko motsutsana ndi Paulo ndi Barnaba, nawathamangitsa ku mzinda wawo.
Paulo ndi Barnaba anakantha fumbi la mzinda wawo ku mapazi awo ngati umboni, napita ku Ikoniyo.
Ndipo ophunzira anadzazidwa ndi chisangalalo ndi Mzimu Woyera.
Izi zimene zinachitika ku Ikoniyo. Paulo ndi Barnaba analowa m'sunagoge la aYuda, nalalikira ndi mphamvu yokha kuti chiwerengero chachikulu cha aYuda ndi aGentaili anakhulupirira.
Koma aYuda amene anakana anafufuza maganizo a aGentaili motsutsana ndi abale.
Atumwi anakhala kumeneko nthawi yayitali, akulalikira molimba za chisomo cha Ambuye. Ambuye anapereka umboni wa uthenga wawo powapatsa mphamvu yochita zizindikiro zankhondo ndi zodabwitsa.
Koma anthu a mzinda anagawika. Ena anatsatira aYuda, ena anatumwi.
Kenako gulu la aGentaili ndi aYuda pamodzi ndi otsogolera awo anasankha kuwakanira miyala.
Atumwi amva izi, nathawira chigawo cha Likaoniya ku mzinda wa Lusitra ndi Derebe ndi malo azungulira.
Ndipo kumeneko analengeza uthenga wabwino.
Paulo ndi Barnaba ali ku Lusitra, anapeza munthu wina wolamala mapazi kuyambira kubadwa kwake, amene sanayendemo nthawi yonse. Anakhala
namvetsera Paulo akulankhula. Paulo anamuyang'ana naona kuti anali ndi chikhulupiriro chochiritsiwa.
Nanena mokweza, "Imirira wongoka!" Mwamsanga anasikira pa mapazi ake, nayamba kuyenda.
Anthu agulu laona zimene Paulo anachita, nafuwula m'zilankhulo zawo, "Milungu yafanana ndi anthu yasika kwa ife!"
Anakhulupirira Barnaba anali Zeusi, ndi Paulo anali Hermesi chifukwa anali woyankhula woyamba.
Tsopano kachisi wa Zeusi anali pafupi ndi mzinda. Wansembe wake pamodzi ndi gulu analowa ndi ng'ombe ndi masamba pa zipata za mzinda, nali ndi maganizo apereka nsembe kwa atumwi.
Koma atumwi Barnaba ndi Paulo amva izi, anaduluza zokuvinika zawo nasenda pakati pa gulu, nafuwula,

"Abwenzi, n'chifukwa chiyani mukuchita izi? Ife nawo tiri anthu wamba ngati inu! Tabweretsani uthenga wabwino kuti mutembenuke kuchoka ku zinthu izi zopanda ntchito mupite kwa Mulungu wamoyo amene anapanga thambo, ndi dziko lapansi, ndi nyanja, ndi chilichonse chimene chili mmenemo.
M'nthawi zapitazo analola mitundu yonse kuthandala m'njira zawo yokha,
ngakhale motero sanasiirepo popanda umboni wa iye mwini ndi ubwino wake. Chifukwa anatumizira mvula ndi mbewu zabwino, napatsa chakudya ndi chisangalalo m'mitima yanu."
Ngakhale ndi mawu awa, Paulo ndi Barnaba ankachitikapo kuchepetsa gulu kumupereka nsembe.
Kenako aYuda ochokera ku Antiokeya ndi ku Ikoniyo anabwera nangosokoneza gulu. Anakanira Paulo miyala, namukokera kunja kwa mzinda, naganiza kuti anafa.
Koma okhulupirira anamuzungulira, anaimirira nalowa m'mzindamo. Tsiku lotsatira anapita ndi Barnaba ku Derebe.
Atalankhula uthenga wabwino ku Derebe nakopetsa ophunzira ambiri, Paulo ndi Barnaba anabwerera ku Lusitra, ndi ku Ikoniyo, ndi ku Antiokeya wa Pisidiya,
nalimbitsa okhulupirira. Nawaimbira mtima kuti apitirire m'chikhulupiriro, nawauza kuti tiyenera kupita pa mavuto angapo kuti tilowe m'ufumu wa Mulungu.
Paulo ndi Barnabayo nasankha akuluakulu m'mpingo uliwonse. Ndi mapemphero ndi kusala chakudya, nawapeleka kwa Ambuye amene anali kukhamira iwo.
Kenako anayenda mu Pisidiya, napita ku Pamfiliya.
Analengeza mawu ku Perga, kenako anatsikira ku Ataliya.
Kuchokera kumeneko anabwerera ndi bwato ku Antiokeya, kumene anayambira ulendo. Kumeneko anakhulupiritsidwa m'chisomo cha Mulungu ku ntchito imene tsopano atamaliza.
Atafika ku Antiokeya, anasonkhanitsa mpingo, nalengeza zonse zimene Mulungu anachita kudzera mwa iwo ndi mmene Mulungu anatsegulira khomo la chikhulupiriro kwa aGentaili.
Ndipo anakhala kumeneko ndi okhulupirira nthawi yayitali.
Paulo ndi Barnabas ali ku Antiokeya wa Suriya, amuna ena ochokera ku Yudeya anabwera nayamba kuphunzitsa okhulupirira, "Ngati simudulidwa malinga ndi malamulo a Mose, simungathe kupulumuka."

Paulo ndi Barnaba anakangana nawo kwambiri. Pamapeto pake mpingo unasankha kutumiza Paulo ndi Barnaba ku Yerusalemu pamodzi ndi okhulupirira ena kuti akakambane ndi atumwi ndi akuluakulu za nkhani imeneyi.
Mpingo natumizidwa ku Yerusalemu, anasamukira kudzera ku Foinike ndi Samariya, nalengeza kutembenuka kwa aGentaili. Izi zinasangalatsa okhulupirira onse.
Atafika ku Yerusalemu, mpingo wonse, atumwi ndi akuluakulu nawakumbatira. Paulo ndi Barnaba nalalikira za zonse zimene Mulungu anachita kudzera mwa iwo.
Koma okhulupirira ena ochokera gulu la aFarisi anaimirira, nati, "Otembenukira chikhulupiriro mwa aGentaili ayenera kudulidwa ndi kumvera chilamulo cha Mose."
Choncho atumwi ndi akuluakulu anasonkhana kukambirane nkhani imeneyi.
Pa msonkhano, atangokambirane nthawi yayitali, Petro anaimirira nati, "Abale, mukudziwa kuti kalekale Mulungu anasankha ine pakati panu kuti aGentaili adzamve uthenga wabwino ndi kukhulupirira.
Mulungu wodziwa mitima yawo anapereka umboni wa kuwalandira ndi kuwapatsa Mzimu Woyera, monga anatichitira ife.
Sanasiyane pakati pathu ndi iwo, nayeretsa mitima yawo kudzera m'chikhulupiriro.
Tsopano n'chifukwa chiyani mukusokoneza Mulungu kuchita khosi pa okhulupirira a aGentaili, ndi khosi imene makolo athu kapena ife sitinathe kunyamula?
Koma tikukhulupirira kuti timapulumutsidwa onse mmodzi kupyolera chisomo chosaopsa cha Ambuye Yesu."
Onse anagona pamene Barnaba ndi Paulo anaulula za zizindikiro zankhondo ndi zodabwitsa zimene Mulungu anachita kudzera mwa iwo pakati pa aGentaili.
Atamaliza, Yakobo anaimirira nati, "Abale, imvirani.
Simoni waululira mmene Mulungu anayamba kuonetsa chifuniro chake kwa aGentaili, kusankha anthu kuchokera mwa iwo kukhala a dzina lake.
Ndipo izi zikugwirizana ndi mawu a aneneri, monga zalembedwa:
'Nditatha ichi ndidzabwerera ndi kubwezera nyumba ya Davide yagwa. Ndidzamanga ziswali zake ndi kuibwezera,
kuti anthu otsala afunefune Ambuye, kuphatikizapo aGentaili onse amene nditcha dzina langa pa iwo. Ambuye wanena izi,
amene waziwulura zonse izi kale lino.'
"Choncho chiweruzo changa ndi chakuti tisasandike aGentaili amene atembenuka kwa Mulungu.
Koma tiwalembere kuti asakudye chakudya chauperewere, ndi kuchita machimo a thupi, ndi nyama ya chiyama, ndi magazi.
Chifukwa malamulo a Mose alalikidwa m'masinagoge m'mzinda uliwonse pa Sabata yonse kwa mibadwo yambiri."

Kenako atumwi ndi akuluakulu pamodzi ndi mpingo wonse wa ku Yerusalemu anasankha anthu, natumiza ku Antiokeya wa Suriya ndi Paulo ndi Barnaba kulalikira chigamulo ichi. Amuna asankhidwa anali otsogolera awiri a mpingo, Yuda (wotchedwa Barsaba) ndi Sila.
Makalata amene anapita nawo anali awa: "Atumwi ndi akuluakulu, abale anu a ku Yerusalemu, kutumizira okhulupirira a aGentaili ku Antiokeya ndi Suriya ndi Kilikiya. Moni!
Tamva kuti amuna ena achokera kwa ife na kukusokonezerani ndi chiphunzitso, koma ife sinatumize iwo!
Choncho tagwirizana kutumiza kwa inu anthu athu, pamodzi ndi Barnaba ndi Paulo amene tikuwakonda,
amene anapereka miyoyo yawo chifukwa cha dzina la Ambuye wathu Yesu Khristu.
Tatumiza Yuda ndi Sila kuti naonenso adzakulatizirani mawu amenewa.
Chifukwa chinakondwetsa Mzimu Woyera ndi ife kuti sitiike ngolo yaikulu pa inu kupita pa zofunika izi:
Musakudye chakudya chapeleweredwa ndi mafano, ndi magazi, ndi nyama yophedwa ndi kujimanga, ndi machimo a thupi. Mukasungirira izi, mudzachita bwino. Tsalani bwino."
Atumizidwa anabwera ku Antiokeya mwamsanga, nasonkhanitsa mpingo wonse, napereka kalata.
Okhulupirira atawerenga, nasangalala chifukwa cha mawu oimbira mtima.
Yuda ndi Sila, omwe onse ali aneneri, analankhula kwa okhulupirira nthawi yayitali, nawaimbira mtima ndi kuwamanga.
Anakhala kanthawi, kenako okhulupirira nawatumiza mwa mtendere ku mpingo wa ku Yerusalemu.
Paulo ndi Barnaba anakhala ku Antiokeya. Pamodzi ndi ena ambiri, aphunzitsa ndi kulengeza mawu a Ambuye.
Patatha nthawi, Paulo anauza Barnaba, "Tizabwerenso kukaona okhulupirira m'mzinda uliwonse kumene inalankhulirwa mawu a Ambuye, ndi kuona ali bwanji."
Barnaba anagwirizana ndi kukufuna kutenga Yohane Maliko nawo.
Koma Paulo saifuna kutenga iye chifukwa analeka iwo ku Pamfiliya, sanapitirize nawo m'ntchito.
Mkangano wawo unakula kwambiri moti analekaneratu. Barnaba anatenga Maliko, nawomba nyanja kupita ku Kupro.
Paulo anasankha Sila, napita, atumizidwa m'chisomo cha Ambuye ndi okhulupirira.
Anayenda m'Suriya ndi Kilikiya yonse nalimbikitsa mipingo.
Paulo anapita ku Derebe, kenako ku Lusitra, kumene panali ophunzira wina dzina lake Timoteyo. Amayi ake anali Myuda okhulupirira, koma abambo ake anali Mgriki.
Timoteyo anali watemwedwa ndi okhulupirira a ku Lusitra ndi ku Ikoniyo,
choncho Paulo anafuna aye naye pa ulendo wawo. Adulidwe chifukwa cha aYuda okhala m'dera lomwe, chifukwa onse ankudziwa kuti abambo ake anali Mgriki.
Kenako anapita mzinda ndi mzinda, nafunzitsa okhulupirira kuti asunga malamulo osankhidwa ndi atumwi ndi akuluakulu ku Yerusalemu.
Choncho mipingo inakhazikika m'chikhulupiriro nawonjezeka m'chiwerengero tsiku ndi tsiku.
Paulo ndi Sila anayenda m'chigawo cha Furigiya ndi Galatiya chifukwa Mzimu Woyera anawaletsa kulankhula mawu mu chigawo cha Asiya pa nthawi imeneyo.
Anafika pa malire a Musiya, nafuna kupita kumpoto ku Bitiniya, koma Mzimu wa Yesu sanawapase mpata.
Choncho m'malo mwake, anadutsa Musiya, napita ku Tirowa.
Usiku umenewo Paulo anaona masomphenya: munthu wina wa ku Makedoniyo anaimirira, nakupempha, "Tiyani ku Makedoniyo unthandize!"
Ataona masomphenya aja, tinayesetsa kukachoka ku Makedoniyo mwamsanga, tizindikira kuti Mulungu watitumiza kulengeza uthenga wabwino kumeneko.
Tinayenda nyanja kuchoka ku Tirowa molunjika ku chilumba cha Samotirake, ndipo tsiku lotsatira tinafika ku Neapoli.
Kuchokera kumeneko tinafika ku Filipi, mzinda waukulu wa gawo la Makedoniyo, ndi koloni ya aRoma. Tinakhala kumeneko kwa masiku angapo.
Pa Sabata, tinachoka panja pang'ono pa mzinda kupita kumtsinje kumene tinkaganiza anthu ankasonkhana kupemphera, tinakhala, tinalankhula ndi amayi amene anali osonkhana.
Mmodzi wa iwo anali Lidiya wa ku Tiyatira, wogulitsa nsalu yafiira yali ngweru, woopa Mulungu. Ambuye anatsegula mtima wake namvera zimene Paulo anauza.
Iye ndi nyumba yake yonse anabatizidwa, natipempha, "Ngati mukuona kuti ndine wokhulupirira Ambuye, bwerani ndi kukhala m'nyumba yanga." Ndipo anatikakamizira mpaka tagwirizana.
Tsiku lina tikipita ku malo a mapemphero, tinapeza mtsikana wina wogwedezedwa ndi mzimu wa ulosi. Anali kupeza mwini wake ndalama zambiri ndi kulalika.
Mtsikana uyu analondola Paulo ndi ife, nafuwula, "Anthu awa ndi atumiki a Mulungu Wamkululukulu, akukulalikira njira ya chipulumutso."
Ichi chinachitika masiku ambiri mpaka Paulo anakhumudwa, natembenuka nati kwa chiwanda mwa iye, "M'dzina la Yesu Khristu ndikuuza kuti utuluke mwa iye." Nthawi yomweyo chinatuluka.
Eni ake aona kuti chiyembekezo chawo cha kupeza ndalama chachoka, anagwira Paulo ndi Sila, nakokera ku bwalo la mzinda kwa olamulira.
Nawayimikitsa pamaso pa aofisala a mzinda, nanena, "Anthu awa, aYuda, akusokoneza mzinda wathu!
Akulalikira miyambo yoipa, imene ife aRoma tiyenera kuitengera."
Gulu linatsatira motsutsana, aofisala a mzinda nalalamula kuti zichupire zovala zawo nawaswanya ndi ndodo.
Ataswanyidwa kwambiri, nawaika m'ndende. Woonda ndende analamulika kuti asamethe.
Choncho iye nawayika m'chipinda chachozama, nayika mapazi awo m'mapako.
Pafupifupi pakati pa usiku Paulo ndi Sila anali kupemphera ndi kuyimba nyimbo zotamanda Mulungu, ndipo akaidi anzawo amvetsera.
Mwamsanga panabwera chikukumuka chachikulu, machilalo a ndende anagwedezeka mpaka maziko awo. Zitseko zonse zinatsegulidwa nthawi yomweyo, maunyolo a mkhaidi uliwonse anathyolidwa!
Woonda ndende anadzuka, naona zitseko za ndende zitsegulidwa. Anaganiza kuti akaidi anathawa, choncho anakoka lupanga kuti yipha yekha.
Koma Paulo anafuwula, "Usaziipire! Tili pano tonse!"
Woonda ndende anapempha nyali, nathamanga m'cipinda chachozama, nagwada nanjenjemera pamaso pa Paulo ndi Sila.
Nawatulutsa napempha, "Ambuyewa, kodi ndichite chiyani kuti nzipulumuke?"
Anayankha, "Khulupirira Ambuye Yesu ndipo udzapulumuka, iwe ndi nyumba yako yonse."
Ndipo anayankhula mawu a Ambuye kwa iye ndi onse a nyumba yake.
Ngakhale pa nthawi imeneyo ya usiku, woonda ndende anawatenga, nasamba zilonda zawo. Kenako iye ndi nyumba yake yonse anabatizidwa nthawi yomweyo.
Nawabweretsa m'nyumba yake nakachika chakudya, nasangalala iye ndi nyumba yake yonse popeza anakhulupirira Mulungu.
M'mawa mwake aofisala a mzinda natumiza asilikali kuti auze woonda ndende, "Masulirani amuna aja!"
Choncho woonda ndende anauza Paulo, "Aofisala a mzinda anauza kuti inu ndi Sila mumasulidwe. Chokani m'mtendere."
Koma Paulo anayankha, "Anatiswanya pa bwalo popanda mlandu, ndi kutisandika m'ndende, ife anthu a chiRoma. Tsopano akufuna kutitulutsa msiri? Ayi! Bwera iwo okha kutulutsa ife!"
Asilikali nauza aofisala mawu amenewa. Iwo nanaopa kwambiri amva kuti Paulo ndi Sila anali anthu a chiRoma.
Choncho anabwera ku ndende, nawaombeza. Kenako nawatulutsa ndi kuwapempha achoke mzindamo.
Paulo ndi Sila atachoka m'ndende, anabwerera ku nyumba ya Lidiya. Kumeneko anakumana ndi okhulupirira nawaimbira mtima. Kenako anachoka mzindawo.
Paulo ndi Sila anayenda m'mizinda ya Amfipoli ndi Apoloniya, nafika ku Tesalonika, kumene panali sunagoge ya aYuda.
Monga ankachita Paulo, analowa ku sunagoge pa ntchito ya Sabata, nalingalira nawo ndi Malembo Sabata zitatu zitatizana.
Anafotokozera ndi kuonetsa kuti Mesiya anayenera kumva zowawa ndi kuuka kwa akufa. Anati, "Yesu ameneyu amene ndikukulalikira iye ndiye Mesiya."
Ena a aYuda amene anamvetsera anakhulupirira, nadziphatikiza ndi Paulo ndi Sila, pamodzi ndi aGentaili ambiri oopa Mulungu ndi amayi achuma.
Koma aYuda ena anadzazidwa ndi nsanje, choncho anasonkhanitsa anthu oyipa m'bwalo la mzinda ndi kuyamba chisokonezo. Anakanira nyumba ya Yason, nafuna kupeza Paulo ndi Sila kuti abwere kwa gulu.
Sanapeze iwo kumeneko, choncho nakokera Yason ndi okhulupirira ena kwa olamulira a mzinda. Nafuwula, "Paulo ndi Sila atasokoneza dziko lonse, tsopano anabwera kuno,
ndipo Yason wawalandira. Onse ndi oipa, akuumirira mfumu ina, dzina lake Yesu."
Anthu a mzinda ndi olamulira anasokonezereka kwambiri amva izi.
Aofisala nalamula Yason ndi okhulupirira azikamire, kenako anawasiya.
Usiku umwoyo okhulupirira anatumiza Paulo ndi Sila ku Beroya. Atafika kumeneko, analowa m'sunagoge ya aYuda.

Anthu a ku Beroya anali ndi mtima wotsekulidwa kuposa anthu a ku Tesalonika, ndipo anamvetsera uthenga wa Paulo molasira. Anaona Malembo tsiku ndi tsiku kuti ndichoonadi zimene Paulo ndi Sila anaphunzitsa.
Chifukwa chake aYuda ambiri anakhulupirira, monga nayenso aGentaili achuma aamuna ndi amayi.
Koma aYuda ena a ku Tesalonika amva kuti Paulo akulalikira mawu a Mulungu ku Beroya, anabwera nayambitsa chisokonezo.
Okhulupirira anachita msanga, natumiza Paulo pafupi ndi nyanja, pamene Sila ndi Timoteyo anatsalira.
Amene anapita naye Paulo anapita naye mpaka ku Atene, kenako anabwerera ku Beroya ndi malangizo kwa Sila ndi Timoteyo kuti adutse msanga kwa iye.
Paulo akadikirira iwo ku Atene, mtima wake unakasuka kwambiri akaona mafano ozala m'mzinda.
Analowanso m'sunagoge kukambirana ndi aYuda ndi aGentaili oopa Mulungu, ndi tsiku ndi tsiku pa bwalo lalikulu la mzinda ndi aliyense amene anapeza.
Anayambanso kukambirana ndi ena mwa aphunzitsi a Epikuriyo ndi Stoiko. Ena anati, "Wamwano ameneyu akufuna kunena chiyani ndi maganizo ake okhaokha?" Ena anati, "Akulankhulira milungu yachilendo."
Kenako namkokera ku bwalo lalikulu la mzinda. Anati, "Bwera utifotokozerere chiphunzitso chako chatsopano.
Ukunena zinthu zodabwitsa, ndipo tifuna kudziwa zimene izi zitanthauza."
(Kuyenera kufotokozera kuti aAteni onse ndi alendo a ku Atene ankatumizira nthawi yawo yonse pakukambirana ndi kumva maganizo atsopano.)
Choncho Paulo, waimirira pamaso pa bwalo, analankhula motere: "Anthu a ku Atene, ndikuona kuti muli olambira kwambiri m'njira iliyonse,

chifukwa ndikuyenda naona malo anu akulambira, ndipanso nsanja imodzi inali ndi cholembedwa, 'Kwa Mulungu Wosadziwika.' Mulunguyu amene mukukhulupirira popanda kumudziwa, ndiye amene ndikukulankhulirani za iye.
Iye ndiye Mulungu amene anapanga dziko ndi chilichonse chimene chili mmenemo. Popeza iye ndi Ambuye wa thambo ndi dziko lapansi, sakhala m'nyumba zimangidwa ndi manja a anthu,
ndipo manja a anthu samutumikira, popeza iye sachitikapo nsangu. Iye mwini amapereka moyo ndi mpweya kwa chilichonse, ndi kuthetsa nsangu zonse.
Mwa munthu mmodzi anapanga mitundu yonse ya anthu kukhala m'dziko lonse lapansi. Anasankha kale nthawi imene iyenera kukula ndi kufera, ndi malire awo.
Cholinga chake chinali kuti mitundu ifunefune Mulungu ndi mwina kufunafuna ndi kumupeza, ngakhale iye sali kutali ndi aliyense wa ife.
Chifukwa mwa iye tikhala, tiyenda ndi kukhalapo. Monga ena a inu aziimbiri anauza, 'Ife ndife ana ake.'
Choncho popeza tiri ana a Mulungu, sayenera kuganiza kuti Mulungu afanana ndi golidi, kapena siliva, kapena mwala, wapangidwa ndi luso ndi maganizo a munthu.
Mulungu analola kusadziwa kwa anthu m'nthawi zapitazo, koma tsopano akulamula anthu m'malo onse atembenuke mtima.
Chifukwa waikidwa tsiku la koweruza dziko lapansi ndi chilungamo kudzera mwa munthu amene wasankha, napereka umboni kwa onse pomuukitsa kwa akufa."
Amva Paulo akunena za kuuka kwa akufa, ena anaseka mozaba, koma ena anati, "Tifuna kumvananso za ichi."
Izi zinatha mkambano wa Paulo nawo,
koma ena analumikizidwa naye nakhulupirira. Pakati pawo panali Diyonisiyo, wa bwalo lalikulu, ndi mkazi wina dzina lake Damari, ndi ena pamodzi nawo.
Kenako Paulo anachoka ku Atene, napita ku Korinto.

Kumeneko analandira Myuda wina dzina lake Akwila, wobadwira ku Ponito, amene anabwera posachedwa kuchokera ku Italiya ndi mkazi wake Prisila. Anachoka ku Italiya pamene Klaudio Kaisara anaturutsa aYuda onse ku Roma.
Paulo anakhalira nawo, nachitiranso ntchito, chifukwa anali opanga mahema monga Paulo mwini.
Pa Sabata iliyonse, anali m'sunagoge, nayesetsa kukhulupirisha aYuda ndi aGentaili.
Sila ndi Timoteyo atatsika ku Makedoniyo, Paulo anadzika nthawi yake yonse kulalikira mawu. Anapereka umboni kwa aYuda kuti Yesu ndiye Mesiya.
Koma atamukanira ndi kumunyoza, Paulo anakantha fumbi la zovala zake, nati, "Magazi anu agwe pa inu nokha, ine ndine wopanda mlandu. Kuyambira tsopano ndidzapita kwa aGentaili."
Kenako anachoka napita ku nyumba ya munthu wina dzina lake Titiyo Yusitu, Mgentaili woopa Mulungu, yemwe nyumba yake inali pafupi ndi sunagoge.
Krispo, mtsogoleri wa sunagoge, ndi nyumba yake yonse anakhulupirira Ambuye. Ena ambiri a ku Korinto amva Paulo, nakhulupirira, nabatizidwa.
Usiku umodzi Ambuye analankhula ndi Paulo mu masomphenya, "Usaope! Lankhula! Usagone!
Chifukwa ndili ndi iwe, ndipo palibe amene adzakukanira ndi kukupha, chifukwa anthu ambiri m'mzinda uno ali anga."
Choncho Paulo anakhala kumeneko zaka imodzi ndi hafu, naphunzitsa mawu a Mulungu.
Galio atalandira ulamuliro wa Akaya, aYuda ena anaimirira pamodzi motsutsana ndi Paulo, namkokera ku bwalo laweruzira.
Namchitira mlandu, "Munthu uyu akukhulupirisha anthu kulambira Mulungu m'njira yolekana ndi chilamulo chathu."
Koma Paulo atayamba kuyankha, Galio anauza ochichitira mlandu, "Tamverani, inu aYuda, ngati mkangano uchi unali za ukwenyo kapena tchimo lalikulu, ndikanalandira mlandu wanu.
Koma chifukwa nkhani ndi ya mawu ndi mayina ndi chilamulo chanu, zisamalireni nokha. Sindisankha kuweruza nkhani zaotere."
Namthamangitsa kuchoka ku bwalo.
Anthu pagulu anamgwira Sostene mtsogoleri wa sunagoge, namswanya pa bwalo lomwelo. Koma Galio sanasamalire zilichonse za izi.

Paulo anakhala ku Korinto nthawi yayitali atatha izi, kenako nalonjeza abale nachoka. Anapita ku Senkereya pafupi, kumeneko anadulidwa tsitsi monga mw'miyambo ya chiYuda, kupereka umboni wa lonjezano lake. Kenako anayomba nyanja kupita ku Suriya, akutenga Prisila ndi Akwila.
Anaimira ku Efeso, kumene Paulo anasiya anzake. Iye analowa m'sunagoge kukambirana ndi aYuda.
Anapempha akhale nthawi yayitali, koma anakana.
Koma ali kuchoka, anati, "Ndidzabweranso ngati Mulungu afuna." Kenako anayomba nyanja kuchoka ku Efeso.
Ataima ku Kaisariya, anapita nakacheza ndi mpingo wa ku Yerusalemu, kenako anabwerera ku Antiokeya.
Atachitikapo nthawi ku Antiokeya, Paulo anabweranso m'chigawo cha Galatiya ndi Furigiya, nalimbikitsa okhulupirira onse.
Pa nthawi imeneyo, Myuda wina dzina lake Apolo, walankhula bwino ndi wodziwa Malembo bwino, anabwera ku Efeso kuchokera ku Alekisandiriya ku Iguputo.
Analandira malangizo m'Njira ya Ambuye, naphunzitsa ena za Yesu ndi changu ndi kuchita molondola. Komabe ankadziwa ubatizo wa Yohane okha.
Anayamba kulankhula molimba m'sunagoge. Prisila ndi Akwila amva iye, namtenga pa mbali, namfotokozera Njira ya Mulungu molondola kwambiri.

Apolo anafuna kupita ku Akaya, ndipo abale ku Efeso namuimbira mtima ndi kulembera mpingo wa ku Akaya kuti amulandire. Atafika, anali wathandiza kwambiri kwa amene anakhulupirira chifukwa cha chisomo cha Mulungu.
Anakana aYuda m'mkambano wapoyera ndi mphamvu. Ndi Malembo, anaonetsa kuti Yesu ndiye Mesiya.
Apolo ali ku Korinto, Paulo anadutsa m'malo akati a dziko, nafika ku Efeso, kumene anapeza ophunzira angapo.
Anafunsa, "Munalandira Mzimu Woyera pamene munakhulupirira?" Anayankha, "Ai, tinasanamva ngakhale kuti Mzimu Woyera alipo."
Anafunsa, "Kodi munabatizidwa mwa ubatizo wanji?" Anayankha, "Ubatizo wa Yohane."
Paulo anati, "Ubatizo wa Yohane unaitana anthu kutembenuka mtima kwa tchimo. Koma Yohane mwini anauza anthu akhulupirire amene adzabwera m'tsogolo mwake, kutanthauza Yesu."
Amva izi, anabatizidwa m'dzina la Ambuye Yesu.
Kenako Paulo anaika manja ake pa iwo, Mzimu Woyera anabwera pa iwo, nalankhula zilankhulo zina ndi kunenera.
Anali pafupifupi amuna khumi ndi awiri tonse.
Kenako Paulo analowa m'sunagoge nalankhula molimba kwa miyezi itatu, nakambirana nawo za ufumu wa Mulungu.

Koma ena anakhala ndi mtima wolimbika, nakanira uthenga ndi kunena zonyansa za Njira poyera. Choncho Paulo anachoka m'sunagoge, natenga okhulupirira naye. Tsiku ndi tsiku anali kukambirana ku sala ya Tiranosi.
Izi zinachitika zaka ziwiri, kuti anthu onse a chigawo cha Asiya, aYuda ndi aGentaili, anamva mawu a Ambuye.
Mulungu anapatsa Paulo mphamvu yochita zizindikiro zankhondo zodabwitsa.
Ngakhale zituta kapena zovala zimene zinatudzula thupi lake zinalengedwa pa odwala, matenda anachotsedwa, ndi mizimu yoyipa inatuluka.
Gulu la aYuda onotha ziwanda anayesa kutumiza dzina la Ambuye Yesu kwa iwo amene anali ndi mizimu yoyipa, nanena, "Ndikukuuza m'dzina la Yesu amene Paulo akulalikira!"
Ana asanu ndi awiri a Skewa mkulu wansembe, anali kuchita izi.
Koma nthawi imodzi pamene anayesetsa ichi, chiwanda chinayankha, "Ndidziwa Yesu, ndi kudziwa Paulo, koma inu ndinu ndani?"
Ndipo munthu wina wogwedezedwa ndi chiwanda anasikira pa iwo, nawagonjetsa, nawagwera ndi mphamvu yokha moti anathawira kunja kwa nyumba, aulula ndi zakudula.
Nkhani imeneyi inazika msanga ku Efeso kwa aYuda ndi aGentaili. Mantha ukulu unagwira onse, dzina la Ambuye Yesu linatamandidwa kwambiri.
Ambiri a amene anakhulupirira anabwera ndi kuvomera mwayera zochita zawo zoipa.
Ambiri a amene anagwira ufiti anabweretsa mabuku awo nati awaotche pa bwalo poyera. Mtengo wa mabuku amenewa unali wa ndalama zambiri.
Choncho uthenga wa Ambuye unachazika ndi mphamvu yaikulu.
Atatha izi Paulo anasintha mu Mzimu kupita ku Makedoniyo ndi ku Akaya, asanabwere ku Yerusalemu. "Nditatha kumeneko," anati, "niyenera kupitanso ku Roma!"
Natumiza athandizi ake awiri, Timoteyo ndi Erasto, ku Makedoniyo, pamene iye anakhala kanthawi m'chigawo cha Asiya.
Pa nthawi imeneyo panabwera chisokonezo chachikuru ku Efeso cha Njira.
Chinayamba ndi Demetiriyo, wopereka siliva, amene anali ndi bizinesi yaikuru yapanga makuwa a siliva a mulungu wamkazi wa chiGreki, Aritemi. Anapatsa anthu ake ngalande zambiri.
Anasonkhanitsa iwo, pamodzi ndi antchito ena a ntchito yofanana, nanena, "Abwenzi, mukudziwa kuti chuma chathu chichokera ku bizinesi iyi.
